paper.title: CoCo: Efficient Browser Extension Vulnerability Detection via Coverage-guided, Concurrent Abstract Interpretation
paper.description: Extensions complement web browsers with additional functionalities and also bring new vulnerability venues, allowing privilege escalations from adversarial web pages to use extension APIs. Prior works on extension vulnerability detection adopt classic static analysis, which is unable to handle dynamic JavaScript features such as those function calls as part of array lookups. At the same time, prior abstract interpretation focuses on lightweight server-side JavaScript, which often cannot scale to client-side extension code due to object explosions in the abstract domain.
paper.author: Jianjia Yu, Song Li, Junmin Zhu, Yinzhi Cao
paper.summary_zh: 浏览器扩展在增强浏览器功能的同时引入新的漏洞途径，使恶意网页可能提权并使用扩展 API。先前扩展漏洞检测工作采用经典静态分析，难以处理数组查找中的函数调用等动态 JavaScript 特性。同时，先前抽象解释主要面向轻量级服务器端 JavaScript，因抽象域对象爆炸往往无法扩展到客户端扩展代码。本文提出 CoCo，一种覆盖率引导、并发抽象解释的浏览器扩展漏洞检测方法。其目标是高效检测扩展漏洞，防止从对抗性网页到扩展 API 的权限提升。

paper.title: Password-Stealing without Hacking: Wi-Fi Enabled Practical Keystroke Eavesdropping
paper.description: The contact-free sensing nature of Wi-Fi has been leveraged to achieve privacy breaches, yet existing attacks relying on Wi-Fi CSI (channel state information) demand hacking Wi-Fi hardware to obtain desired CSIs. Since such hacking has proven prohibitively hard due to compact hardware, its feasibility in keeping up with fast-developing Wi-Fi technology becomes very questionable. To this end, we propose WiKI-Eve to eavesdrop keystrokes on smartphones without the need for hacking. WiKI-Eve exploits a new feature, BFI (beamforming feedback information), offered by latest Wi-Fi hardware: since BFI is transmitted from a smartphone to an AP in clear-text, it can be overheard (hence eavesdropped) by any other Wi-Fi devices switching to monitor mode. As existing keystroke inference methods offer very limited generalizability, WiKI-Eve further innovates in an adversarial learning scheme to enable its inference generalizable towards unseen scenarios. We implement WiKI-Eve and conduct extensive evaluation on it; the results demonstrate that WiKI-Eve achieves 88.9% inference accuracy for individual keystrokes and up to 65.8% top-10 accuracy for stealing passwords of mobile applications (e.g., WeChat).
paper.author: Jingyang Hu, Hongbo Wang, Tianyue Zheng, Jingzhi Hu, Zhe Chen, Hongbo Jiang, Jun Luo
paper.summary_zh: 现有基于 Wi-Fi CSI 的免接触感知攻击需要破解 Wi-Fi 硬件才能获取所需信道状态信息，随着硬件集成度提高，这种攻击的可行性日益存疑。本文提出 WiKI-Eve，无需硬件破解即可窃听智能手机上的击键。WiKI-Eve 利用最新 Wi-Fi 硬件提供的波束成形反馈信息（BFI）：由于 BFI 从智能手机到 AP 以明文传输，任何切换到监听模式的 Wi-Fi 设备都可窃听。针对现有击键推断方法泛化性有限的问题，论文引入对抗学习方案，使推断能够泛化到未见场景。实验表明，WiKI-Eve 对单个击键的推断准确率达 88.9%，在窃取移动应用（如微信）密码时 top-10 准确率最高达 65.8%。

paper.title: Travelling the Hypervisor and SSD: A Tag-Based Approach Against Crypto Ransomware with Fine-Grained Data Recovery
paper.description: Ransomware has evolved from an economic nuisance to a national security threat nowadays, which poses a significant risk to users. To address this problem, we propose RansomTag, a tag-based approach against crypto ransomware with fine-grained data recovery. Compared to state-of-the-art SSD-based solutions, RansomTag makes progress in three aspects. First, it decouples the ransomware detection functionality from the firmware of the SSD and integrates it into a lightweight hypervisor of Type I. Thus, it can leverage the powerful computing capability of the host system and the rich context information, which is introspected from the operating system, to achieve accurate detection of ransomware attacks and defense against potential targeted attacks on SSD characteristics. Further, RansomTag is readily deployed onto desktop personal computers due to its parapass-through architecture. Second, RansomTag bridges the semantic gap between the hypervisor and the SSD through the tag-based approach proposed by us. Third, RansomTag is able to keep 100% of the user data overwritten or deleted by ransomware, and restore any single or multiple user files to any versions based on timestamps. To validate our approach, we implement a prototype of RansomTag and collect 3,123 recent ransomware samples to evaluate it. The evaluation results show that our prototype effectively protects user data with minimal scale data backup and acceptable performance overhead. In addition, all the attacked files can be completely restored in fine-grained.
paper.author: Boyang Ma, Yilin Yang, Jinku Li, Fengwei Zhang, Wenbo Shen, Yajin Zhou, Jianfeng Ma
paper.summary_zh: 勒索软件已从经济骚扰演变为国家安全威胁，对用户数据构成重大风险。本文提出 RansomTag，一种基于标签的加密货币勒索软件防御与细粒度数据恢复方案。与最先进的基于 SSD 的方案相比，RansomTag 将勒索软件检测功能从 SSD 固件解耦到轻量级 Type I hypervisor，从而利用主机计算能力和从操作系统内省获得的丰富上下文，准确检测攻击并抵御针对 SSD 特性的定向攻击。它通过标签方法弥合 hypervisor 与 SSD 之间的语义鸿沟，并采用 parapass-through 架构便于部署到桌面个人计算机。RansomTag 能保留 100% 被勒索软件覆盖或删除的用户数据，并可按时间戳将任意单个或多个用户文件恢复到任意版本。使用 3,123 个近期勒索软件样本评估表明，原型以极小备份规模和可接受性能开销有效保护数据，且所有被攻击文件均可完全细粒度恢复。

paper.title: SysPart: Automated Temporal System Call Filtering for Binaries
paper.description: Restricting the system calls available to applications reduces the attack surface of the kernel and limits the functionality available to compromised applications. Recent approaches automatically identify the system calls required by programs to block unneeded ones. For servers, they even consider different phases of execution to tighten restrictions after initialization completes. However, they require access to the source code for applications and libraries, depend on users identifying when the server transitions from initialization to serving clients, or do not account for dynamically-loaded libraries. This paper introduces SYSPART, an automatic system-call filtering system designed for binary-only server programs that addresses the above limitations. Using a novel algorithm that combines static and dynamic analysis, SYSPART identifies the serving phases of all working threads of a server. Static analysis is used to compute the system calls required during the various serving phases in a sound manner, and dynamic observations are only used to complement static resolution of dynamically-loaded libraries when necessary. We evaluated SYSPART using six popular servers on x86-64 Linux to demonstrate its effectiveness in automatically identifying serving phases, generating accurate system-call filters, and mitigating attacks. Our results show that SYSPART outperforms prior binary-only approaches and performs comparably to source-code approaches.
paper.author: Vidya Lakshmi Rajagopalan, Konstantinos Kleftogiorgos, Enes Göktas, Jun Xu, Georgios Portokalidis
paper.summary_zh: 限制应用可用的系统调用能缩小内核攻击面并约束被攻陷应用的功能。已有自动识别所需系统调用的方法对服务器还会考虑不同执行阶段，但通常需要源码、依赖用户识别服务器从初始化到服务客户端的切换，且未处理动态加载库。本文提出 SysPart，面向仅二进制服务器程序的自动系统调用过滤系统。它结合静态与动态分析的新算法，识别服务器所有工作线程的服务阶段；静态分析以可靠方式计算各服务阶段所需系统调用，动态观察仅在必要时补充解析动态加载库。在 x86-64 Linux 上对六个流行服务器评估表明，SysPart 能自动识别服务阶段、生成准确系统调用过滤器并缓解攻击，优于先前仅二进制方法，性能与源码方法相当。

paper.title: FetchBench: Systematic Identification and Characterization of Proprietary Prefetchers
paper.description: Prefetchers speculatively fetch memory using predictions on future memory use by applications. Different CPUs may use different prefetcher types, and two implementations of the same prefetcher can differ in details of their characteristics, leading to distinct runtime behavior. For a few implementations, security researchers showed through manual analysis how to exploit specific prefetchers to leak data. Identifying such vulnerabilities required tedious reverse-engineering, as prefetcher implementations are proprietary and undocumented. So far, no systematic study of prefetchers in common CPUs is available, preventing further security assessment.
paper.author: Till Schlüter, Amit Choudhari, Lorenz Hetterich, Leon Trampert, Hamed Nemati, Ahmad Ibrahim, Michael Schwarz, Christian Rossow, Nils Ole Tippenhauer
paper.summary_zh: 预取器会根据对应用未来内存使用的预测来推测性获取内存；不同 CPU 可能使用不同预取器类型，同一预取器的两种实现也可能存在细节差异，导致运行时行为不同。安全研究者曾通过人工分析利用特定预取器泄露数据，但预取器实现专有且无文档，识别此类漏洞需要繁琐逆向工程。目前尚缺乏对常见 CPU 中预取器的系统性研究，阻碍了进一步安全评估。本文提出 FetchBench，对专有预取器进行系统性识别与刻画。该工作为理解预取器特性、评估潜在侧信道风险提供了系统化基础。

paper.title: Scalable Multiparty Garbling
paper.description: Multiparty garbling is the most popular approach for constant-round secure multiparty computation (MPC). Despite being the focus of significant research effort, instantiating prior approaches to multiparty garbling results in constant-round MPC that can not realistically accommodate large numbers of parties. In this work we present the first global-scale multiparty garbling protocol. The per-party communication complexity of our protocol decreases as the number of parties participating in the protocol increases - for the first time matching the asymptotic communication complexity of non-constant round MPC protocols. Our protocol achieves malicious security in the honest-majority setting and relies on the hardness of the Learning Party with Noise assumption.
paper.author: Gabrielle Beck, Aarushi Goel, Aditya Hegde, Abhishek Jain, Zhengzhong Jin, Gabriel Kaptchuk
paper.summary_zh: 多方 garbling 是常量轮安全多方计算（MPC）的主流方案，但既往实例化方法难以支持大量参与方，通信开销随参与方数量增长而不可扩展。本文提出首个全局规模的多方 garbling 协议，其单方通信复杂度随参与方数量增加而下降，首次匹配非常量轮 MPC 协议的渐近通信复杂度。该协议在诚实多数设置下实现恶意安全，安全性依赖 Learning Parity with Noise（LPN）假设。

paper.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Automated Tools for Side-Channel Vulnerabilities Detection in Cryptographic Libraries
paper.description: To protect cryptographic implementations from side-channel vulnerabilities, developers must adopt constant-time programming practices. As these can be error-prone, many side-channel detection tools have been proposed. Despite this, such vulnerabilities are still manually found in cryptographic libraries. While a recent paper by Jancar et al. shows that developers rarely perform side-channel detection, it is unclear if existing detection tools could have found these vulnerabilities in the first place.
paper.author: Antoine Geimer, Mathéo Vergnolle, Frédéric Recoules, Lesly-Ann Daniel, Sébastien Bardin, Clémentine Maurice
paper.summary_zh: 为保护密码实现免受侧信道漏洞影响，开发者必须采用常量时间编程实践，但这类实践容易出错，因此已有许多侧信道检测工具被提出。尽管如此，密码库中此类漏洞仍常被人工发现；Jancar 等人近期工作表明开发者很少执行侧信道检测，但尚不清楚现有检测工具是否本可发现这些漏洞。本文对密码库中侧信道漏洞检测的自动化工具进行系统性评估。通过评估工具能力与局限，论文分析其能否发现真实库中的漏洞，并为工具改进和开发者使用提供指导。

paper.title: Interactive Proofs For Differentially Private Counting
paper.description: Differential Privacy (DP) is often presented as a strong privacy-enhancing technology with broad applicability and advocated as a de facto standard for releasing aggregate statistics on sensitive data. However, in many embodiments, DP introduces a new attack surface: a malicious entity entrusted with releasing statistics could manipulate the results and use the randomness of DP as a convenient smokescreen to mask its nefariousness. Since revealing the random noise would obviate the purpose of introducing it, the miscreant may have a perfect alibi. To close this loophole, we introduce the idea of Interactive Proofs For Differential Privacy, which requires the publishing entity to output a zero knowledge proof that convinces an efficient verifier that the output is both DP and reliable. Such a definition might seem unachievable, as a verifier must validate that DP randomness was generated faithfully without learning anything about the randomness itself. We resolve this paradox by carefully mixing private and public randomness to compute verifiable DP counting queries with theoretical guarantees and show that it is also practical for real-world deployment. We also demonstrate that computational assumptions are necessary by showing a separation between information-theoretic DP and computational DP under our definition of verifiability.
paper.author: Ari Biswas, Graham Cormode
paper.summary_zh: 差分隐私（DP）常被视为发布敏感数据聚合统计的标准技术，但发布方可能利用 DP 的随机噪声掩盖对统计结果的恶意操纵，形成新的攻击面。本文提出面向差分隐私的交互式证明（Interactive Proofs For Differential Privacy），要求发布实体输出零知识证明，使验证者确信输出既满足 DP 又可靠。作者通过仔细混合私有随机性和公有随机性，构造可验证的 DP 计数查询，并给出理论保证与实用部署评估。同时证明在所定义可验证性下计算假设是必要的，并展示信息论 DP 与计算 DP 之间的分离。

paper.title: "Get in Researchers; We're Measuring Reproducibility": A Reproducibility Study of Machine Learning Papers in Tier 1 Security Conferences
paper.description: Reproducibility is crucial to the advancement of science; it strengthens confidence in seemingly contradictory results and expands the boundaries of known discoveries. Computer Security has the natural benefit of creating artifacts that should facilitate computational reproducibility, the ability for others to use someone else's code and data to independently recreate results, in a relatively straightforward fashion. While the Security community has recently increased its attention on reproducibility, an independent and comprehensive measurement of the current state of reproducibility has not been conducted. In this paper, we perform the first such study, targeting reproducible artifacts generated specifically by papers on machine learning security (one of the most popular areas in academic research) published in Tier 1 security conferences over the past ten years (2013-2022). We perform our measurement study of indirect and direct reproducibility over nearly 750 papers, their codebases, and datasets. Our analysis shows that there is no statistically significant difference between the availability of artifacts before and after the introduction of Artifact Evaluation Committees in Tier 1 conferences. However, based on three years of results, artifacts that pass through this process work at a higher rate than those that do not. From our collected findings, we offer data-driven suggestions for improving reproducibility in our community, including five common problems observed in our study. In so doing, we demonstrate that significant progress still needs to be made in computational reproducibility in Computer Security research.
paper.author: Daniel Olszewski, Allison Lu, Carson Stillman, Kevin Warren, Cole Kitroser, Alejandro Pascual, Divyajyoti Ukirde, Kevin Butler, Patrick Traynor
paper.summary_zh: 可复现性是科学进步的关键，计算机安全领域本应因代码和数据artifact而更易实现计算可复现，但社区缺乏对当前可复现性状态的独立、全面测量。本文首次针对一级安全会议过去十年（2013-2022）中机器学习安全方向论文所生成的artifact，开展可复现性研究。作者对近 750 篇论文、代码库和数据集进行间接与直接可复现性测量。结果显示，引入 Artifact Evaluation Committees 前后artifact可用性无统计显著差异，但通过AEC评审的artifact运行成功率更高。基于发现，论文提出数据驱动的改进建议，并总结五类常见问题，表明安全研究在计算可复现性上仍需显著进步。

paper.title: Efficient Query-Based Attack against ML-Based Android Malware Detection under Zero Knowledge Setting
paper.description: The widespread adoption of the Android operating system has made malicious Android applications an appealing target for attackers. Machine learning-based (ML-based) Android malware detection (AMD) methods are crucial in addressing this problem; however, their vulnerability to adversarial examples raises concerns. Current attacks against ML-based AMD methods demonstrate remarkable performance but rely on strong assumptions that may not be realistic in real-world scenarios, e.g., the knowledge requirements about feature space, model parameters, and training dataset. To address this limitation, we introduce AdvDroidZero, an efficient query-based attack framework against ML-based AMD methods that operates under the zero knowledge setting. Our extensive evaluation shows that AdvDroidZero is effective against various mainstream ML-based AMD methods, in particular, state-of-the-art such methods and real-world antivirus solutions.
paper.author: Ping He, Yifan Xia, Xuhong Zhang, Shouling Ji
paper.summary_zh: Android 恶意应用泛滥，基于机器学习的 Android 恶意软件检测（AMD）方法至关重要，但其对对抗样本的脆弱性引发担忧。现有针对 ML-based AMD 的攻击虽然性能显著，却依赖对特征空间、模型参数和训练数据集等强假设，在现实场景中往往不成立。本文提出 AdvDroidZero，一种在零知识设置下运行的高效基于查询的 ML-based AMD 攻击框架。大量评估表明，AdvDroidZero 能有效攻击多种主流 ML-based AMD 方法，特别是最先进方法和真实杀毒软件解决方案。

paper.title: Stateful Defenses for Machine Learning Models Are Not Yet Secure Against Black-box Attacks
paper.description: Recent work has proposed stateful defense models (SDMs) as a compelling strategy to defend against a black-box attacker who only has query access to the model, as is common for online machine learning platforms. Such stateful defenses aim to defend against black-box attacks by tracking the query history and detecting and rejecting queries that are "similar" and thus preventing black-box attacks from finding useful gradients and making progress towards finding adversarial attacks within a reasonable query budget. Recent SDMs (e.g., Blacklight and PIHA) have shown remarkable success in defending against state-of-the-art black-box attacks. In this paper, we show that SDMs are highly vulnerable to a new class of adaptive black-box attacks. We propose a novel adaptive black-box attack strategy called Oracle-guided Adaptive Rejection Sampling (OARS) that involves two stages: (1) use initial query patterns to infer key properties about an SDM's defense; and, (2) leverage those extracted properties to design subsequent query patterns to evade the SDM's defense while making progress towards finding adversarial inputs. OARS is broadly applicable as an enhancement to existing black-box attacks - we show how to apply the strategy to enhance six common black-box attacks to be more effective against current class of SDMs. For example, OARS-enhanced versions of black-box attacks improved attack success rate against recent stateful defenses from almost 0% to to almost 100% for multiple datasets within reasonable query budgets.
paper.author: Ryan Feng, Ashish Hooda, Neal Mangaokar, Kassem Fawaz, Somesh Jha, Atul Prakash
paper.summary_zh: 近期研究提出有状态防御模型（SDM），通过跟踪查询历史并检测、拒绝相似查询，来防御仅能查询模型的黑盒攻击。Blacklight 和 PIHA 等 SDM 在抵御最先进黑盒攻击上表现突出。本文表明 SDM 对一类新的自适应黑盒攻击高度脆弱。作者提出 Oracle-guided Adaptive Rejection Sampling（OARS），分两阶段：先利用初始查询模式推断 SDM 防御的关键属性，再据此设计后续查询模式以规避防御并寻找对抗输入。OARS 可广泛用于增强现有黑盒攻击，作者将六种常见黑盒攻击增强后，在合理查询预算内对近期有状态防御的成功率从几乎 0% 提升到几乎 100%。

paper.title: Vulnerability Intelligence Alignment via Masked Graph Attention Networks
paper.description: Cybersecurity vulnerability information is often sourced from multiple channels, such as government vulnerability repositories, individually maintained vulnerability-gathering platforms, or vulnerability-disclosure email lists and forums. Integrating vulnerability information from different channels enables comprehensive threat assessment and quick deployment to various security mechanisms. However, automatic integration of vulnerability information, especially those lacking decisive information (e.g., CVE-ID), is hindered by the limitations of today's entity alignment techniques.
paper.author: Yue Qin, Yue Xiao, Xiaojing Liao
paper.summary_zh: 网络安全漏洞信息常来自政府漏洞库、独立维护的漏洞收集平台以及漏洞披露邮件列表和论坛等多渠道，整合这些信息有助于全面威胁评估和快速部署安全机制。然而，当漏洞信息缺少 CVE-ID 等决定性标识时，现有实体对齐技术难以实现自动整合。本文提出基于掩码图注意力网络（Masked Graph Attention Networks）的漏洞情报对齐方法，利用图结构和上下文特征对齐跨渠道漏洞实体。该工作旨在突破当前实体对齐局限，提升多源漏洞信息自动整合的准确性与可用性。

paper.title: PANIC: PAN-assisted Intra-process Memory Isolation on ARM
paper.description: Intra-process memory isolation is a well-known technique to enforce least privilege within a process. In this paper, we propose a generic and efficient intra-process memory isolation technique named PANIC, by leveraging Privileged Access Never (PAN) and load/store unprivileged (LSU) instructions on AArch64. PANIC executes process code in kernel mode and compartments code into trusted and untrusted components. The untrusted code is restricted from accessing the isolated memory region, which is located on user pages, and the trusted code is allowed to access the isolated memory region by using LSU instructions. To mitigate threats induced by running user code in kernel mode, PANIC provides two novel security mechanisms: shim-based memory isolation and sensitive instruction emulation. PANIC provides a generic and efficient isolation primitive that can be applied in three different isolation scenarios: protecting sensitive data in CFI, creating isolated execution environments, and hardening JIT code cache. We have implemented a prototype of PANIC and experimental evaluation shows that PANIC incurs very low performance overhead, and performs better than existing methods.
paper.author: Jiali Xu, Mengyao Xie, Chenggang Wu, Yinqian Zhang, Qijing Li, Xuan Huang, Yuanming Lai, Yan Kang, Wei Wang, Qiang Wei, Zhe Wang
paper.summary_zh: 进程内内存隔离是在单个进程内实施最小权限的常用技术，但在 ARM 平台上兼顾通用性与低开销仍具挑战。本文提出 PANIC，利用 AArch64 的 Privileged Access Never（PAN）和 load/store unprivileged（LSU）指令，将进程代码运行在内核态并把代码划分为可信与不可信组件。不可信代码被禁止访问位于用户页面的隔离内存区域，而可信代码可通过 LSU 指令访问该区域；同时 PANIC 设计了 shim 内存隔离和敏感指令模拟两种机制来缓解用户代码运行在内核态带来的风险。原型评估显示 PANIC 性能开销很低，并优于现有方法，可应用于保护 CFI 敏感数据、创建隔离执行环境和加固 JIT 代码缓存等场景。

paper.title: T unne L s for B ootlegging: Fully Reverse-Engineering GPU TLBs for Challenging Isolation Guarantees of NVIDIA MIG
paper.description: Recent studies have revealed much detailed information about the translation lookaside buffers (TLBs) of modern CPUs, but we find that many properties of such components in modern GPUs still remain unknown or unclear. To fill this knowledge gap, we develop a new GPU TLB reverse-engineering method and apply it to a variety of consumer- and server-grade GPUs in Turing and Ampere generations. Aside from learning significantly more comprehensive and accurate GPU TLB properties, we discover a design flaw of NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) feature. MIG claims full partitioning of the entire GPU memory system for secure GPU sharing in cloud computing. However, we surprisingly find that MIG does not partition the last-level TLB, which is shared by all the compute units in a GPU. Exploiting this design flaw and learned TLB properties, we are able to construct a covert channel for data exfiltration across MIG-enforced isolation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attack on MIG. We evaluate the proposed attack on a commercial cloud platform, and we successfully achieve reliable data exfiltration from a victim tenant at a speed of up to 31 kbps with a very high accuracy around 99.8%. Even when the victim is using the GPU for deep neural network training, the transmission can still reach more than 25 kbps with a more than 99.5% accuracy. We propose and implement a mitigation approach that can effectively thwart data exfiltration through this covert channel. Additionally, we present a preliminary study on exploiting the access patterns of the last-level TLB to infer the identity of applications running in other MIG-created GPU instances.
paper.author: Zhenkai Zhang, Tyler Allen, Fan Yao, Xing Gao, Rong Ge
paper.summary_zh: 现代 CPU 的 TLB 已有较多研究，但 GPU TLB 的许多特性仍不清楚。本文提出一种 GPU TLB 逆向工程方法，并在 Turing 与 Ampere 世代的消费级和服务器级 GPU 上开展实验，获得了更全面准确的 GPU TLB 属性。研究发现 NVIDIA MIG 存在设计缺陷：MIG 声称对 GPU 内存系统进行完全分区以保证云中安全共享，却未对最后一级 TLB 进行分区，而该 TLB 被 GPU 内所有计算单元共享。利用该缺陷和 TLB 属性，作者构建了跨越 MIG 隔离的隐蔽信道，在商业云平台上实现最高约 31 kbps、准确率约 99.8% 的数据外泄；即使受害者在训练深度神经网络，仍可达到 25 kbps 以上和超过 99.5% 的准确率。论文还提出并实现了可有效阻断该隐蔽信道的缓解方案，并初步研究了利用最后一级 TLB 访问模式推断其他 MIG 实例应用身份的方法。

paper.title: Towards Practical Sleepy BFT
paper.description: Bitcoin's longest-chain protocol pioneered consensus under dynamic participation, also known as sleepy consensus, where nodes do not need to be permanently active. However, existing solutions for sleepy consensus still face two major issues, which we address in this work. First, existing sleepy consensus protocols have high latency (either asymptotically or concretely). We tackle this problem and achieve 4Δ latency (Δ is the bound on network delay) in the best case, which is comparable to classic BFT protocols without dynamic participation support. Second, existing protocols have to assume that the set of corrupt participants remains fixed throughout the lifetime of the protocol due to a problem we call costless simulation. We resolve this problem and support growing participation of corrupt nodes. Our new protocol also offers several other important advantages, including support for arbitrary fluctuation of honest participation as well as an efficient recovery mechanism for new active nodes.
paper.author: Dahlia Malkhi, Atsuki Momose, Ling Ren
paper.summary_zh: 比特币的最长链协议首次实现了动态参与下的共识（sleepy consensus），允许节点不必一直在线，但现有 sleepy 共识仍存在两个主要问题：延迟高，以及因无成本模拟问题而必须假设腐败节点集合固定。本文提出新的 sleepy BFT 协议，在最佳情况下达到 4Δ 延迟，与不支持动态参与的经典 BFT 协议相当。该协议还支持腐败节点参与度增长、诚实参与度任意波动，并为新活跃节点提供高效恢复机制。

paper.title: Short Privacy-Preserving Proofs of Liabilities
paper.description: In the wake of fraud scandals involving decentralized exchanges and the significant financial loss suffered by individuals, regulators are pressed to put mechanisms in place that enforce customer protections and capital requirements in decentralized ecosystems. Proof of liabilities (PoL) is such a mechanism: it allows a prover (e.g., an exchange) to prove its liability to a verifier (i.e., a customer).
paper.author: Francesca Falzon, Kaoutar Elkhiyaoui, Yacov Manevich, Angelo De Caro
paper.summary_zh: 在去中心化交易所欺诈丑闻和用户重大财务损失之后，监管机构需要机制来强制执行客户保护和资本要求。负债证明（Proof of Liabilities, PoL）允许证明方（如交易所）向验证方（如客户）证明其负债，是其中一种机制。本文提出短隐私保护负债证明，目标是在保持证明简洁的同时不泄露用户余额等敏感信息。摘要片段未给出具体构造和实验数据，但该工作聚焦于面向去中心化生态的隐私保护 PoL 方案。

paper.title: Threshold Signatures from Inner Product Argument: Succinct, Weighted, and Multi-threshold
paper.description: Threshold signatures protect the signing key by sharing it among a group of signers so that an adversary must corrupt a threshold number of signers to be able to forge signatures. Existing threshold signatures with succinct signatures and constant verification times do not work if signers have different weights. Such weighted settings are seeing increasing importance in decentralized systems, especially in the Proof-of-Stake blockchains. This paper presents a new paradigm for threshold signatures for pairing and discrete logarithm-based cryptosystems. Our scheme has a compact verification key consisting of only 7 group elements, and a signature consisting of 8 group elements. Verifying the signature requires 8 exponentiations and 8 bilinear pairings. Our scheme supports arbitrary weight distributions among signers and arbitrary thresholds. It requires non-interactive preprocessing after a universal powers-of-tau setup. We prove the security of our scheme in the Algebraic Group Model and implement it using Golang. Our evaluation shows that our scheme achieves a comparable signature size and verification time to a standard (unweighted) threshold signature. Compared to existing multisignature schemes, our scheme has a much smaller public verification key.
paper.author: Sourav Das, Philippe Camacho, Zhuolun Xiang, Javier Nieto, Benedikt Bünz, Ling Ren
paper.summary_zh: 门限签名通过在一组签名者之间共享签名密钥来保护密钥，但现有兼具简洁签名和常数验证时间的门限签名方案不支持签名者权重不同的场景，而这种加权设置在权益证明等去中心化系统中日益重要。本文提出一种面向配对和离散对数密码系统的新门限签名范式，支持任意权重分布和任意门限。该方案验证密钥仅 7 个群元素，签名仅 8 个群元素，验证需要 8 次指数运算和 8 次双线性配对；在通用 powers-of-tau 设置后仅需非交互式预处理。作者在代数群模型中证明安全性，并用 Golang 实现；评估显示其签名大小和验证时间与标准非加权门限签名相当，且公钥验证密钥远小于现有多签名方案。

paper.title: How Hard is Takeover in DPoS Blockchains? Understanding the Security of Coin-based Voting Governance
paper.description: Delegated-Proof-of-Stake (DPoS) blockchains, such as EOSIO, Steem and TRON, are governed by a committee of block producers elected via a coin-based voting system. We recently witnessed the first de facto blockchain takeover that happened between Steem and TRON. Within one hour of this incident, TRON founder took over the entire Steem committee, forcing the original Steem community to leave the blockchain that they maintained for years. This is a historical event in the evolution of blockchains and Web 3.0. Despite its significant disruptive impact, little is known about how vulnerable DPoS blockchains are in general to takeovers and the ways in which we can improve their resistance to takeovers.
paper.author: Chao Li, Balaji Palanisamy, Runhua Xu, Li Duan, Jiqiang Liu, Wei Wang
paper.summary_zh: EOSIO、Steem 和 TRON 等委托权益证明（DPoS）区块链通过代币投票选举区块生产者委员会进行治理。Steem 与 TRON 之间发生的首次事实上的区块链接管事件，使 TRON 创始人在一小时内控制了整个 Steem 委员会，迫使原社区离开；但人们对 DPoS 链普遍易受接管攻击的程度及如何提升抵抗力仍知之甚少。本文旨在理解基于代币投票治理的 DPoS 区块链接管难度，分析其脆弱性并探索改进抵抗力的方法。该工作以真实接管事件为动机，聚焦 DPoS 治理安全，但摘要未展开具体分析框架与实验结果。

paper.title: Comprehension from Chaos: Towards Informed Consent for Private Computation
paper.description: Private computation, which includes techniques like multi-party computation and private query execution, holds great promise for enabling organizations to analyze data they and their partners hold while maintaining data subjects' privacy. Despite recent interest in communicating about differential privacy, end users' perspectives on private computation have not previously been studied. To fill this gap, we conducted 22 semi-structured interviews investigating users' understanding of, and expectations for, private computation over data about them. Interviews centered on four concrete data-analysis scenarios (e.g., ad conversion analysis), each with a variant that did not use private computation and another that did. While participants struggled with abstract definitions of private computation, they found the concrete scenarios enlightening and plausible even though we did not explain the complex cryptographic underpinnings. Private computation increased participants' acceptance of data sharing, but not unconditionally; the purpose of data sharing and analysis was the primary driver of their attitudes. Through collective activities, participants emphasized the importance of detailing the purpose of a computation and clarifying that inputs to private computation are not shared across organizations when describing private computation to end users.
paper.author: Bailey Kacsmar, Vasisht Duddu, Kyle Tilbury, Blase Ur, Florian Kerschbaum
paper.summary_zh: 私有计算技术如多方计算和私有查询执行，有望让组织在保护数据主体隐私的同时分析数据，但终端用户对私有计算的理解和期望此前未被研究。本文通过 22 个半结构化访谈，围绕四个具体数据分析场景（每个场景包含使用和不使用私有计算的变体）展开调查。参与者虽然难以理解私有计算的抽象定义，但认为具体场景具有启发性且可信，即使未解释复杂密码学原理。私有计算提高了参与者对数据共享的接受度，但并非无条件接受；数据共享和分析的目的仍是其态度的首要驱动因素。集体活动还表明，向终端用户描述私有计算时，应详细说明计算目的，并澄清输入不会在组织间共享。

paper.title: AntiFake: Using Adversarial Audio to Prevent Unauthorized Speech Synthesis
paper.description: The rapid development of deep neural networks and generative AI has catalyzed growth in realistic speech synthesis. While this technology has great potential to improve lives, it also leads to the emergence of ''DeepFake'' where synthesized speech can be misused to deceive humans and machines for nefarious purposes. In response to this evolving threat, there has been a significant amount of interest in mitigating this threat by DeepFake detection.
paper.author: Zhiyuan Yu, Shixuan Zhai, Ning Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 随着深度神经网络和生成式 AI 的发展，逼真语音合成技术可能被滥用于 DeepFake，欺骗人类和机器。现有工作多关注事后 DeepFake 检测，而本文提出 AntiFake，利用对抗音频扰动来阻止未授权的语音合成。其核心思路是在原始音频中加入难以察觉的对抗扰动，使基于该音频的语音克隆或合成系统难以生成可用的伪造语音。该工作将防御前置到语音生成环节，为对抗语音 DeepFake 提供了一种主动防护方向。

paper.title: Unforgeability in Stochastic Gradient Descent
paper.description: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is a popular training algorithm, a cornerstone of modern machine learning systems. Several security applications benefit from determining if SGD executions are forgeable, i.e., whether the model parameters seen at a given step are obtainable by more than one distinct set of data samples. In this paper, we present the first attempt at proving impossibility of such forgery. We furnish a set of conditions, which are efficiently checkable on concrete checkpoints seen during training runs, under which checkpoints are provably unforgeable at that step. Our experiments show that the conditions are somewhat mild and hence always satisfied at checkpoints sampled in our experiments. Our results sharply contrast prior findings at a high level: We show that checkpoints we find to be provably unforgeable have been deemed to be forgeable using the same methodology and experimental setup suggested in prior work. This discrepancy arises because of unspecified subtleties in definitions. We experimentally confirm that the distinction matters, i.e., small errors amplify during training to produce significantly observable difference in final models trained. We hope our results serve as a cautionary note on the role of algebraic precision in forgery definitions and related security arguments.
paper.author: Teodora Baluta, Ivica Nikolic, Racchit Jain, Divesh Aggarwal, Prateek Saxena
paper.summary_zh: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是现代机器学习系统的基石，一些安全应用需要判断 SGD 执行是否可伪造，即某一步的模型参数能否由不止一组不同的数据样本得到。本文首次尝试证明此类伪造不可能，给出了一组可在训练检查点上高效检查的条件；当满足这些条件时，该步的检查点可证明是不可伪造的。实验表明这些条件相当温和，在实验采样的检查点上总是满足。该结果与先前工作形成鲜明对比：先前方法和实验设置下被认为可伪造的检查点，在本文定义下可证明不可伪造，差异源于定义中未明确的细微之处；实验还确认这种区别确实重要，小误差会在训练中放大并导致最终模型出现显著可观察差异。

paper.title: Do Users Write More Insecure Code with AI Assistants?
paper.description: AI code assistants have emerged as powerful tools that can aid in the software development life-cycle and can improve developer productivity. Unfortunately, such assistants have also been found to produce insecure code in lab environments, raising significant concerns about their usage in practice. In this paper, we conduct a user study to examine how users interact with AI code assistants to solve a variety of security related tasks. Overall, we find that participants who had access to an AI assistant wrote significantly less secure code than those without access to an assistant. Participants with access to an AI assistant were also more likely to believe they wrote secure code, suggesting that such tools may lead users to be overconfident about security flaws in their code. To better inform the design of future AI-based code assistants, we release our user-study apparatus to researchers seeking to build on our work.
paper.author: Neil Perry, Megha Srivastava, Deepak Kumar, Dan Boneh
paper.summary_zh: AI 代码助手能提高开发效率，但已有实验室研究发现其可能生成不安全的代码，因此需要了解真实用户使用时的安全后果。本文开展用户研究，让参与者在有无 AI 助手条件下完成多种安全相关编程任务。结果显示，能使用 AI 助手的参与者写出的代码显著更不安全，而且他们更倾向于相信自己写出的代码是安全的。这表明 AI 助手可能让用户对代码中的安全缺陷过度自信，作者还公开了实验装置供后续研究使用。

paper.title: Unhelpful Assumptions in Software Security Research
paper.description: In the study of software security many factors must be considered. Once venturing beyond the simplest of laboratory experiments, the researcher is obliged to contend with exponentially complex conditions. Software security has been shown to be affected by priming, tool usability, library documentation, organisational security culture, the content and format of internet resources, IT team and developer interaction, Internet search engine ordering, developer personality, security warning placement, mentoring, developer experience and more. In a systematic review of software security papers published since 2016, we have identified a number of unhelpful assumptions that are commonly made by software security researchers. In this paper we list these assumptions, describe why they sometimes do not reflect reality, and suggest implications for researchers.
paper.author: Ita Ryan, Utz Roedig, Klaas-Jan Stol
paper.summary_zh: 软件安全受到启动效应、工具可用性、库文档、组织安全文化、互联网资源、开发者互动与经验等多重复杂因素影响，但许多研究在实验室之外仍依赖简化假设。本文对 2016 年以来发表的软件安全论文进行系统综述，识别出研究人员常做出的一系列无益假设。论文列出这些假设，解释它们为何有时不符合现实，并讨论其对软件安全研究设计与结论的影响。

paper.title: CCSW '23: Cloud Computing Security Workshop
paper.description: Clouds and massive-scale computing infrastructures are starting to dominate computing and will likely continue to do so for the foreseeable future. Major cloud operators are now comprising millions of cores hosting substantial fractions of corporate and government IT infrastructure. CCSW is the world's premier forum bringing together researchers and practitioners in all security aspects of cloud-centric and outsourced computing, including:
paper.author: Francesco Regazzoni, Apostolos Fournaris
paper.summary_zh: 本文是 CCSW '23 云计算安全研讨会的介绍，该研讨会关注云与大规模计算基础设施安全。随着主要云运营商拥有数百万核心并承载大量企业与政府 IT 基础设施，云中心和外包计算的安全问题日益重要。CCSW 旨在汇聚云安全领域的研究人员和实践者，讨论云安全各方向的挑战与进展。

paper.title: Fine-Grained Data-Centric Content Protection Policy for Web Applications
paper.description: The vast amount of sensitive data in modern web applications has become a prime target for cyberattacks. Existing browser security policies disallow the execution of unknown scripts, but do not restrict access to sensitive web content by 'trusted' third-party scripts. Therefore, the over-privileged third-party scripts can compromise the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive user data in the applications.
paper.author: Zilun Wang, Wei Meng, Michael R. Lyu
paper.summary_zh: 现代Web应用蕴含大量敏感数据，现有浏览器安全策略虽禁止未知脚本执行，却未限制“可信”第三方脚本访问敏感内容，导致过度权限的第三方脚本可能破坏数据的机密性与完整性。论文提出一种细粒度的、以数据为中心的内容保护策略，旨在对敏感Web内容实施更精确的访问控制，限制第三方脚本对敏感数据的访问。该工作有望在不破坏正常Web功能的前提下，有效缓解第三方脚本带来的数据泄露与篡改风险。

paper.title: Specification and Verification of Side-channel Security for Open-source Processors via Leakage Contracts
paper.description: Leakage contracts have recently been proposed as a new security abstraction at the Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) level. Leakage contracts aim to capture the information that processors leak through their microarchitectural implementations. However, so far, we lack a methodology to verify that a processor actually satisfies a given leakage contract.
paper.author: Zilong Wang, Gideon Mohr, Klaus von Gleissenthall, Jan Reineke, Marco Guarnieri
paper.summary_zh: 处理器微架构实现会通过侧信道泄露信息，泄漏契约作为一种ISA级安全抽象被提出，用于刻画处理器泄露的信息，但目前缺乏验证处理器是否真正满足给定契约的方法。论文提出面向开源处理器的侧信道安全规约与验证方法，可能结合形式化验证与处理器模型，检查微架构实现是否遵守泄漏契约。该方法有助于在设计阶段发现违反契约的侧信道行为，提升开源处理器的安全性。

paper.title: AdCPG: Classifying JavaScript Code Property Graphs with Explanations for Ad and Tracker Blocking
paper.description: Advertising and tracking service (ATS) blocking has been safeguarding the privacy of millions of Internet users from privacy-invasive tracking behaviors. Previous research has proposed using a graph representation that models the structural relationships in loading web resources and then conducting ATS node classification based on this graph representation. However, these context-based ATS classification methods suffer from (1) inconsistent classification due to the varying context in which ATS resources are loaded and (2) a lack of explainability of the classification results, making it difficult to identify the code-level causes for ATS classification.
paper.author: Changmin Lee, Sooel Son
paper.summary_zh: 广告与追踪服务（ATS）拦截是保护用户隐私的重要手段，但现有基于图表示的上下文分类方法因资源加载上下文变化导致分类不一致，且缺乏可解释性，难以定位代码级原因。论文提出AdCPG，利用JavaScript代码属性图对ATS资源进行分类，并生成分类解释，以提升拦截的准确性与可解释性。该工作有望在广告和追踪器拦截场景中提供更稳定、可解释的分类结果，帮助理解ATS资源的代码特征。

paper.title: Deciding Differential Privacy of Online Algorithms with Multiple Variables
paper.description: We consider the problem of checking the differential privacy of online randomized algorithms that process a stream of inputs and produce outputs corresponding to each input. This paper generalizes an automaton model called DiP automata [10] to describe such algorithms by allowing multiple real-valued storage variables. A DiP automaton is a parametric automaton whose behavior depends on the privacy budget ∈. An automaton A will be said to be differentially private if, for some D, the automaton is D∈-differentially private for all values of ∈ > 0. We identify a precise characterization of the class of all differentially private DiP automata. We show that the problem of determining if a given DiP automaton belongs to this class is PSPACE-complete. Our PSPACE algorithm also computes a value for D when the given automaton is differentially private. The algorithm has been implemented, and experiments demonstrating its effectiveness are presented.
paper.author: Rohit Chadha, A. Prasad Sistla, Mahesh Viswanathan, Bishnu Bhusal
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究在线随机算法处理输入流并产生对应输出时的差分隐私验证问题，将DiP自动机模型推广到允许多个实值存储变量。作者给出了所有差分隐私DiP自动机的精确刻画，并证明判定给定自动机是否属于该类的问题是PSPACE完全的。其PSPACE算法还能在自动机满足差分隐私时计算隐私参数D，并已实现和实验验证有效性。

paper.title: Profile-guided System Optimizations for Accelerated Greybox Fuzzing
paper.description: Greybox fuzzing is a highly popular option for security testing, incentivizing tremendous efforts to improve its performance. Prior research has brought many algorithmic advancements, leading to substantial performance growth. However, less attention has been paid to the system-level designs of greybox fuzzing tools, despite the high impacts of such designs on fuzzing throughput.
paper.author: Yunhang Zhang, Chengbin Pang, Stefan Nagy, Xun Chen, Jun Xu
paper.summary_zh: 灰盒模糊测试是安全测试的主流方法，已有大量算法改进，但系统级设计对模糊测试吞吐量的重要影响尚未得到充分关注。论文提出基于性能剖析（profile-guided）的系统优化方法，针对灰盒模糊测试工具的系统级瓶颈进行优化，以加速测试执行。该工作通过系统级剖析与优化提升模糊测试吞吐量，有望提高漏洞发现效率。

paper.title: Compact Frequency Estimators in Adversarial Environments
paper.description: Count-Min Sketch (CMS) and HeavyKeeper (HK) are two realizations of a compact frequency estimator (CFE). These are a class of probabilistic data structures that maintain a compact summary of (typically) high-volume streaming data, and provides approximately correct estimates of the number of times any particular element has appeared. CFEs are often the base structure in systems looking for the highest-frequency elements (i.e., top-K elements, heavy hitters, elephant flows). Traditionally, probabilistic guarantees on the accuracy of frequency estimates are proved under the implicit assumption that stream elements do not depend upon the internal randomness of the structure. Said another way, they are proved in the presence of data streams that are created by non-adaptive adversaries. Yet in many practical use-cases, this assumption is not well-matched with reality; especially, in applications where malicious actors are incentivized to manipulate the data stream. We show that the CMS and HK structures can be forced to make significant estimation errors, by concrete attacks that exploit adaptivity. We analyze these attacks analytically and experimentally, with tight agreement between the two. Sadly, these negative results seem unavoidable for (at least) sketch-based CFEs with parameters that are reasonable in practice. On the positive side, we give a new CFE (Count-Keeper) that can be seen as a composition of the CMS and HK structures. Count-Keeper estimates are typically more accurate (by at least a factor of two) than CMS for "honest" streams; our attacks against CMS and HK are less effective (and more resource intensive) when used against Count-Keeper; and Count-Keeper has a native ability to flag estimates that are suspicious, which neither CMS or HK (or any other CFE, to our knowledge) admits.
paper.author: Sam A. Markelon, Mia Filic, Thomas Shrimpton
paper.summary_zh: Count-Min Sketch和HeavyKeeper等紧凑频率估计器常用于流数据中高频元素的近似计数，其传统精度保证假设数据流由非自适应对手生成。论文证明在自适应攻击下，攻击者可利用结构随机性使CMS和HK产生显著估计错误，且分析结果与实验紧密吻合。为缓解该问题，作者提出Count-Keeper，组合CMS与HK，在诚实流上更准确，对攻击更鲁棒，并能标记可疑估计。

paper.title: Uncle Maker: (Time)Stamping Out The Competition in Ethereum
paper.description: We present and analyze an attack on Ethereum 1's consensus mechanism, which allows miners to obtain higher mining rewards compared to their honest peers. This attack is novel in that it relies on manipulating block timestamps and the difficulty-adjustment algorithm (DAA) to give the miner an advantage whenever block races ensue. We call our attack Uncle Maker, as it induces a higher rate of uncle blocks. We describe several variants of the attack. Among these, one that is risk-free for miners.
paper.author: Aviv Yaish, Gilad Stern, Aviv Zohar
paper.summary_zh: 论文揭示并分析了针对以太坊1共识机制的一种新型攻击“Uncle Maker”，矿工通过操纵区块时间戳和难度调整算法，在区块竞争中获得比诚实矿工更高的挖矿收益。该攻击会提高叔块（uncle block）率，并包含多种变体，其中一种对矿工而言无风险。研究结果对以太坊共识安全与激励设计具有重要影响。

paper.title: Faster Constant-time Evaluation of the Kronecker Symbol with Application to Elliptic Curve Hashing
paper.description: We generalize the Bernstein-Yang (BY) algorithm [11] for constant-time modular inversion to compute the Kronecker symbol, of which the Jacobi and Legendre symbols are special cases. We first develop a basic and easy-to-implement algorithm, defined with full-precision division steps. We then describe an optimized version due to Hamburg [21] over word-sized inputs, and formally verify its correctness. Along the way, we introduce a number of optimizations for implementing both versions in constant time. The resulting algorithms are particularly suitable for computing the Legendre symbol with dense prime p, where no efficient addition chain is known for exponentiating to p-1 over 2, as it is often the case in pairing-friendly elliptic curves. Our high-speed implementation for a range of parameters shows that the new algorithm is up to 40 times faster than exponentiation, and up to 25.7% faster than the previous state of the art. We illustrate our techniques with hashing to elliptic curves using the SwiftEC algorithm [17], with savings of 14.7%-48.1%, and to accelerating the CTIDH isogeny-based key exchange [7], with savings of 3.5-13.5%.
paper.author: Diego F. Aranha, Benjamin Salling Hvass, Bas Spitters, Mehdi Tibouchi
paper.summary_zh: 论文将用于常数时间模逆的Bernstein-Yang算法推广到计算Kronecker符号（Jacobi和Legendre符号为其特例），并提出易于实现的全精度除法版本和基于字长输入的优化版本，且对优化版本进行了形式化验证。作者引入多项常数时间优化，特别适用于稠密素数下的Legendre符号计算，因为此时缺乏高效加法链。实验表明新算法比幂运算快达40倍，比此前最优方法快25.7%，并在SwiftEC椭圆曲线哈希和CTIDH等应用中取得显著加速。

paper.title: Analyzing the Real-World Security of the Algorand Blockchain
paper.description: The Algorand consensus protocol is interesting both in theory and in practice. On the theoretical side, to achieve adaptive security, it introduces the novel idea of player replaceability, where each step of the protocol is executed by a different randomly selected committee whose members remain secret until they send their first and only message. The protocol provides consistency under arbitrary network conditions and liveness under intermittent network partitions. On the practical side, the protocol is used to secure the Algorand cryptocurrency, whose total value is approximately 850M at the time of writing.
paper.author: Erica Blum, Derek Leung, Julian Loss, Jonathan Katz, Tal Rabin
paper.summary_zh: Algorand共识协议通过“玩家可替换性”实现自适应安全，每步由随机选出的秘密委员会执行，并在任意网络条件下提供一致性、在网络分区间歇时提供活性。论文对Algorand区块链在真实世界中的安全性进行系统分析，考察其理论假设与实际部署之间的差距及潜在攻击面。研究结果对保护当时价值约8.5亿美元的Algorand加密货币具有重要意义。

paper.title: Stealing the Decoding Algorithms of Language Models
paper.description: A key component of generating text from modern language models (LM) is the selection and tuning of decoding algorithms. These algorithms determine how to generate text from the internal probability distribution generated by the LM. The process of choosing a decoding algorithm and tuning its hyperparameters takes significant time, manual effort, and computation, and it also requires extensive human evaluation. Therefore, the identity and hyperparameters of such decoding algorithms are considered to be extremely valuable to their owners. In this work, we show, for the first time, that an adversary with typical API access to an LM can steal the type and hyperparameters of its decoding algorithms at very low monetary costs. Our attack is effective against popular LMs used in text generation APIs, including GPT-2, GPT-3 and GPT-Neo. We demonstrate the feasibility of stealing such information with only a few dollars, e.g., 0.8, 1, 4, and 40 for the four versions of GPT-3.
paper.author: Ali Naseh, Kalpesh Krishna, Mohit Iyyer, Amir Houmansadr
paper.summary_zh: 现代语言模型生成文本时依赖解码算法及其超参数，这些信息对模型拥有者极具价值，因为选择和调优需要大量时间、计算和人工评估。论文首次证明仅具有典型API访问权限的对手能够以极低经济成本窃取语言模型所用解码算法的类型和超参数。攻击对GPT-2、GPT-3和GPT-Neo等流行模型有效，例如窃取四个GPT-3版本仅需约0.8、1、4和40美元。

paper.title: Protecting HRP UWB Ranging System Against Distance Reduction Attacks
paper.description: Ultra-wideband (UWB) communication is an emerging technology that enables secure ranging and localization. Since UWB communication enables measuring an exact distance, enhanced security would be expected based on it. Recently, however, it has been demonstrated that a distance measured by IEEE 802.15.4z high-rate pulse repetition frequency (HRP) UWB ranging system can be maliciously reduced. The HRP UWB ranging system is widely adopted by smartphone manufacturers such as Samsung and Apple.
paper.author: Kyungho Joo, Dong Hoon Lee, Yeonseon Jeong, Wonsuk Choi
paper.summary_zh: 超宽带（UWB）通信支持安全测距与定位，但IEEE 802.15.4z HRP UWB测距系统已被证明可被恶意缩短测量距离，威胁智能手机等设备的安全应用。论文针对HRP UWB测距系统提出一种防御距离缩减攻击的保护方案，可能通过检测或补偿攻击引起的测距偏差来确保距离测量真实性。该工作有助于提升广泛部署于三星、苹果等设备的UWB测距安全性。

paper.title: Is Modeling Access Control Worth It?
paper.description: Implementing access control policies is an error-prone task that can have severe consequences for the security of software applications. Model-driven approaches have been proposed in the literature and associated tools have been developed with the goal of reducing the complexity of this task and helping developers to produce secure software efficiently. Nevertheless, there is a lack of empirical data supporting the advantages of model-driven security approaches over code-centric approaches, which are the de-facto industry standard for software development.
paper.author: David Basin, Juan Guarnizo, Srđan Krstic, Hoang Nguyen, Martín Ochoa
paper.summary_zh: 实现访问控制策略容易出错，可能严重危害软件安全，模型驱动方法被提出以降低复杂度，但缺乏与业界主流代码中心方法对比的实证数据。论文通过实验研究评估模型驱动访问控制相对于代码中心方法是否值得采用，考察开发效率、错误率和安全性等指标。结果可为开发者和组织选择访问控制实现方式提供实证依据。

paper.title: TsuKing: Coordinating DNS Resolvers and Queries into Potent DoS Amplifiers
paper.description: In this paper, we present a new DNS amplification attack, named TsuKing. Instead of exploiting individual DNS resolvers independently to achieve an amplification effect, TsuKing deftly coordinates numerous vulnerable DNS resolvers and crafted queries together to form potent DoS amplifiers. We demconstrate that with TsuKing, an initial small amplification factor can inrease exponentially through the internal layers of coordinated amplifiers, resulting in an extremely powerful amplification attack. TsuKing has three variants, including DNSRetry, DNSChain, and DNSLoop, all of which exploit a suite of inconsistent DNS implementations to achieve enormous amplification effect. With comprehensive measurements, we found that about 14.5% of 1.3M open DNS resolvers are potentially vulnerable to TsuKing. Real-world controlled evaluations indicated that attackers can achieve a packet amplification factor of at least 3,700X (DNSChain). We have reported vulnerabilities to affected vendors and provided them with mitigation recommendations. We have received positive responses from 6 vendors, including Unbound, MikroTik, and AliDNS, and 3 CVEs were assigned. Some of them are implementing our recommendations.
paper.author: Wei Xu, Xiang Li, Chaoyi Lu, Baojun Liu, Haixin Duan, Jia Zhang, Jianjun Chen, Tao Wan
paper.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种新的DNS放大攻击TsuKing，其不是单独利用DNS解析器，而是协同大量脆弱解析器与构造查询形成强DoS放大器。TsuKing包含DNSRetry、DNSChain和DNSLoop三种变体，利用DNS实现不一致使初始小放大因子在协调层中指数级增长。对130万个开放DNS解析器的测量显示约14.5%可能易受攻击，受控实验表明DNSChain可实现至少3700倍的包放大。作者向厂商报告漏洞并获得Unbound、MikroTik、AliDNS等6家厂商积极回应，3个CVE被分配。

paper.title: ASHES '23: Workshop on Attacks and Solutions in Hardware Security
paper.description: The workshop on "Attacks and Solutions in HardwarE Security (ASHES)" welcomes any theoretical and practical works on hardware security, including attacks, solutions, countermeasures, proofs, classification, formalization, and implementations. Besides mainstream research, ASHES puts some focus on new and emerging scenarios: This includes the Internet of Things (IoT), nuclear weapons inspections, arms control, consumer and infrastructure security, or supply chain security, among others. ASHES also welcomes works on special purpose hardware, such as lightweight, low-cost, and energy-efficient devices, or non-electronic security systems.
paper.author: Lejla Batina, Chip Hong Chang, Domenic Forte, Ulrich Rührmair
paper.summary_zh: 这是硬件安全攻击与解决方案研讨会ASHES '23的概述，征集并讨论硬件安全的理论与实践工作。主题包括攻击、防御、对策、证明、分类、形式化和实现，并关注物联网、核武器检查、军控、消费与基础设施安全、供应链安全等新兴场景。研讨会也欢迎轻量级、低成本、高能效等专用硬件以及非电子安全系统的研究。该概述反映了硬件安全领域的广泛议题和跨领域应用关注。

paper.title: FutORAMa: A Concretely Efficient Hierarchical Oblivious RAM
paper.description: Oblivious RAM (ORAM) is a general-purpose technique for hiding memory access patterns. This is a fundamental task underlying many secure computation applications. While known ORAM schemes provide optimal asymptotic complexity, despite extensive efforts, their concrete costs remain prohibitively expensive for many interesting applications. The current state-of-the-art practical ORAM schemes are suitable only for somewhat small memories (Square-Root ORAM or Path ORAM).
paper.author: Gilad Asharov, Ilan Komargodski, Yehuda Michelson
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对ORAM在隐藏内存访问模式时具体开销过高、难以实际部署的问题，提出FutORAMa一种具体高效的分层ORAM方案。现有最优实用ORAM方案仅适合较小内存，作者旨在突破这一限制。标题表明其采用分层结构并进行具体效率优化。该工作有望推动ORAM在安全计算等应用中的实际使用。

paper.title: Accio: Variable-Amount, Optimized-Unlinkable and NIZK-Free Off-Chain Payments via Hubs
paper.description: Payment channel hubs (PCHs) serve as a promising solution to achieving quick off-chain payments between pairs of users. They work by using an untrusted tumbler to relay the payments between the payer and payee and enjoy the advantages of low cost and high scalability. However, the most recent privacy-preserving payment channel hub solution that supports variable payment amounts suffers from limited unlinkability, e.g., being vulnerable to the abort attack. Moreover, this solution utilizes zero-knowledge proofs, which bring huge costs on both computation time and communication overhead. Therefore, how to design PCHs that support variable amount payments and unlinkability, but reduce the use of huge-cost cryptographic tools as much as possible, is significant for the large-scale practical applications of off-chain payments.
paper.author: Zhonghui Ge, Jiayuan Gu, Chenke Wang, Yu Long, Xian Xu, Dawu Gu
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对支付通道枢纽中隐私保护方案的问题：支持可变金额但不可链接性有限、易受中止攻击，且依赖零知识证明造成高计算和通信开销。作者提出Accio，一种基于枢纽的链下支付方案，支持可变金额、优化不可链接性并免除NIZK。它通过减少高成本密码工具的使用来提升大规模实用性。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但目标是在保持隐私属性的同时降低成本。

paper.title: Stealth Key Exchange and Confined Access to the Record Protocol Data in TLS 1.3
paper.description: We show how to embed a covert key exchange sub protocol within a regular TLS 1.3 execution, generating a stealth key in addition to the regular session keys. The idea, which has appeared in the literature before, is to use the exchanged nonces to transport another key value. Our contribution is to give a rigorous model and analysis of the security of such embedded key exchanges, requiring that the stealth key remains secure even if the regular key is under adversarial control. Specifically for our stealth version of the TLS 1.3 protocol we show that this extra key is secure in this setting under the common assumptions about the TLS protocol.
paper.author: Marc Fischlin
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究在标准TLS 1.3执行中嵌入隐蔽密钥交换子协议，从而在正常会话密钥之外生成一个隐蔽密钥。其思路利用交换的nonce携带另一个密钥值。作者给出了此类嵌入密钥交换的严格安全模型与分析，要求即使常规密钥被攻击者控制，隐蔽密钥仍保持安全。针对TLS 1.3的隐蔽版本，论文证明在常规TLS假设下该额外密钥仍安全。

paper.title: ParBFT: Faster Asynchronous BFT Consensus with a Parallel Optimistic Path
paper.description: To reduce latency and communication overhead of asynchronous Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) consensus, an optimistic path is often added, with Ditto and BDT as state-of-the-art representatives. These protocols first attempt to run an optimistic path that is typically adapted from partially-synchronous BFT and promises good performance in good situations. If the optimistic path fails to make progress, these protocols switch to a pessimistic path after a timeout, to guarantee liveness in an asynchronous network. This design crucially relies on an accurate estimation of the network delay Δ to set the timeout parameter correctly. A wrong estimation of Δ can lead to either premature or delayed switching to the pessimistic path, hurting the protocol's efficiency in both cases.
paper.author: Xiaohai Dai, Bolin Zhang, Hai Jin, Ling Ren
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注异步拜占庭容错共识中乐观路径设计对网络延迟Δ估计敏感的问题。现有Ditto、BDT等协议先运行乐观路径，超时后切换悲观路径，若Δ估计错误会导致切换过早或过晚，损害效率。作者提出ParBFT，引入并行乐观路径来加快异步BFT共识。摘要未展开实验，但目标是在保证异步活性的同时提升好情况与切换情况下的性能。

paper.title: Verifiable Mix-Nets and Distributed Decryption for Voting from Lattice-Based Assumptions
paper.description: Cryptographic voting protocols have recently seen much interest from practitioners due to their (planned) use in countries such as Estonia, Switzerland, France, and Australia. Practical protocols usually rely on tested designs such as the mixing-and-decryption paradigm. There, multiple servers verifiably shuffle encrypted ballots, which are then decrypted in a distributed manner. While several efficient protocols implementing this paradigm exist from discrete log-type assumptions, the situation is less clear for post-quantum alternatives such as lattices. This is because the design ideas of the discrete log-based voting protocols do not carry over easily to the lattice setting, due to specific problems such as noise growth and approximate relations.
paper.author: Diego F. Aranha, Carsten Baum, Kristian Gjøsteen, Tjerand Silde
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究基于格假设的后量子电子投票协议，聚焦混洗-解密范式中可验证混洗与分布式解密。现有实用投票协议多依赖离散对数型假设，其设计难以直接迁移到格设置，因为噪声增长和近似关系等问题。作者提出基于格的、可验证的混洗网络和分布式解密构造，以支持后量子安全的投票。摘要未给性能数据，但目标是在格假设下实现实用的投票隐私与可验证性。

paper.title: HE3DB: An Efficient and Elastic Encrypted Database Via Arithmetic-And-Logic Fully Homomorphic Encryption
paper.description: As concerns are increasingly raised about data privacy, encrypted database management system (DBMS) based on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) attracts increasing research attention, as FHE permits DBMS to be directly outsourced to cloud servers without revealing any plaintext data. However, the real-world deployment of FHE-based DBMS faces two main challenges: i) high computational latency, and ii) lack of elastic query processing capability, both of which stem from the inherent limitations of the underlying FHE operators. Here, we introduce HE3DB, a fully homomorphically encrypted, efficient and elastic DBMS framework based on a new FHE infrastructure. By proposing and integrating new arithmetic and logic homomorphic operators, we devise fast and high-precision homomorphic comparison and aggregation algorithms that enable a variety of SQL queries to be applied over FHE ciphertexts, e.g., compound filter-aggregation, sorting, grouping, and joining. In addition, in contrast to existing encrypted DBMS that only support aggregated information retrieval, our framework permits further server-side elastic analytical processing over the queried FHE ciphertexts, such as private decision tree evaluation. In the experiment, we rigorously study the efficiency and flexibility of HE3DB. We show that, compared to the state-of-the-art techniques, HE3DB can homomorphically evaluate end-to-end SQL queries as much as 41X-299X faster than the state-of-the-art solution, completing a TPC-H query over a 16-bit 10K-row database within 241 seconds.
paper.author: Song Bian, Zhou Zhang, Haowen Pan, Ran Mao, Zian Zhao, Yier Jin, Zhenyu Guan
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对全同态加密数据库面临高计算延迟和缺乏弹性查询处理的问题，提出HE3DB框架。它基于新的FHE基础设施，集成算术和逻辑同态算子，实现快速高精度同态比较与聚合，从而支持复合过滤-聚合、排序、分组和连接等SQL查询。与仅支持聚合信息检索的现有加密DBMS不同，HE3DB允许服务器端对查询后的密文进行弹性分析，如隐私决策树评估。实验表明，其端到端SQL查询比最优方案快41-299倍，在16位1万行数据库上完成TPC-H查询仅需241秒。

paper.title: Amplification by Shuffling without Shuffling
paper.description: Motivated by recent developments in the shuffle model of differential privacy, we propose a new approximate shuffling functionality called Alternating Shuffle, and provide a protocol implementing alternating shuffling in a single-server threat model where the adversary observes all communication. Unlike previous shuffling protocols in this threat model, the per-client communication of our protocol only grows sub-linearly in the number of clients. Moreover, we study the concrete efficiency of our protocol and show it can improve per-client communication by one or more orders of magnitude with respect to previous (approximate) shuffling protocols. We also show a differential privacy amplification result for alternating shuffling analogous to the one for uniform shuffling, and demonstrate that shuffling-based protocols for secure summation based a construction of Ishai et al. remain secure under the Alternating Shuffle. In the process we also develop a protocol for exact shuffling in single-server threat model with amortized logarithmic communication per-client which might be of independent interest.
paper.author: Borja Balle, James Bell, Adrià Gascón
paper.summary_zh: 该论文受差分隐私shuffle模型启发，提出一种新的近似混洗功能Alternating Shuffle，并给出单服务器威胁模型下、敌手可观察所有通信的协议。与先前方案不同，其每客户端通信量仅随客户端数量亚线性增长，实际可将每客户端通信降低一个或多个数量级。作者还证明Alternating Shuffle具有类似均匀混洗的差分隐私放大效应，并表明基于shuffle的安全求和协议在Alternating Shuffle下仍安全。此外，论文给出单服务器威胁模型下精确混洗协议，每客户端摊还通信为对数级。

paper.title: Decoding the Secrets of Machine Learning in Malware Classification: A Deep Dive into Datasets, Feature Extraction, and Model Performance
paper.description: Many studies have proposed machine-learning (ML) models for malware detection and classification, reporting an almost-perfect performance. However, they assemble ground-truth in different ways, use diverse static- and dynamic-analysis techniques for feature extraction, and even differ on what they consider a malware family. As a consequence, our community still lacks an understanding of malware classification results: whether they are tied to the nature and distribution of the collected dataset, to what extent the number of families and samples in the training dataset influence performance, and how well static and dynamic features complement each other.
paper.author: Savino Dambra, Yufei Han, Simone Aonzo, Platon Kotzias, Antonino Vitale, Juan Caballero, Davide Balzarotti, Leyla Bilge
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对恶意软件分类中机器学习模型常报告近乎完美性能、但实验设置缺乏可比性的问题。作者系统研究了数据集构建、静态/动态特征提取以及模型性能之间的关系。研究关注分类结果是否依赖于所收集数据集的性质与分布，训练集中家族数和样本量对性能的影响，以及静态和动态特征如何互补。该工作旨在揭示当前恶意软件分类评估中的偏差与不足，为后续可复现、公平的ML恶意软件检测研究提供指导。

paper.title: MDTD: A Multi-Domain Trojan Detector for Deep Neural Networks
paper.description: Machine learning models that use deep neural networks (DNNs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. An adversary carrying out a backdoor attack embeds a predefined perturbation called a trigger into a small subset of input samples and trains the DNN such that the presence of the trigger in the input results in an adversary-desired output class. Such adversarial retraining however needs to ensure that outputs for inputs without the trigger remain unaffected and provide high classification accuracy on clean samples. Existing defenses against backdoor attacks are computationally expensive, and their success has been demonstrated primarily on image-based inputs. The increasing popularity of deploying pretrained DNNs to reduce costs of re/training large models makes defense mechanisms that aim to detect 'suspicious' input samples preferable.
paper.author: Arezoo Rajabi, Surudhi Asokraj, Fengqing Jiang, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, James Ritcey, Radha Poovendran
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对深度神经网络的后门攻击，即攻击者在少量输入中嵌入触发器并使模型输出攻击者指定类别。现有防御计算开销大，且主要针对图像输入验证，难以适应预训练模型广泛部署下检测可疑样本的需求。作者提出多域木马检测器MDTD，用于在多个域或模态下检测DNN中的后门触发器。摘要未给具体实验，但目标是以较低成本识别带触发器的可疑输入，适用于不同数据类型。

paper.title: WPES '23: 22nd Workshop on Privacy in the Electronic Society
paper.description: These proceedings contain the papers selected for inclusion in the technical program for the 22st ACM Workshop on Privacy in the Electronic Society (ACM WPES 2023), held in conjunction with the 30th ACM Conference on Computer and Communication Security (ACM CCS 2023) at the Tivoli Congress Center in Copenhagen, Denmark, on November 26, 2023. In response to the workshop's call for papers, 31 valid submissions were received, including 21 full paper submissions and 10 short paper submissions. They were evaluated by a technical program committee consisting of 54 researchers whose backgrounds include a diverse set of topics related to privacy. Each paper was reviewed by at least 3 members of the program committee. Papers were evaluated based on their importance, novelty, and technical quality. After the rigorous review process, 9 submissions were accepted as full papers (acceptance rate: 29.0%) and an additional 8 submissions were accepted as short papers.
paper.author: Bart P. Knijnenburg, Panagiotis Papadimitratos
paper.summary_zh: 这是第22届ACM电子社会隐私研讨会（WPES 2023）的会议论文集概述，该会与CCS 2023合办。研讨会收到31篇有效投稿，其中21篇全文、10篇短文。经54人程序委员会严格评审（每篇至少3人审稿），最终录用9篇全文（录用率29.0%）和8篇短文。该概述反映了隐私领域在电子社会中的研究交流与论文筛选情况。

paper.title: Evaluating the Security Posture of Real-World FIDO2 Deployments
paper.description: FIDO2 is a suite of protocols that combines the usability of local authentication (e.g., biometrics) with the security of public-key cryptography to deliver passwordless authentication. It eliminates shared authentication secrets (i.e., passwords, which could be leaked or phished) and provides strong security guarantees assuming the benign behavior of the client-side protocol components.
paper.author: Dhruv Kuchhal, Muhammad Saad, Adam Oest, Frank Li
paper.summary_zh: FIDO2旨在一方面保留本地认证（如生物识别）的可用性，另一方面利用公钥密码学实现无密码认证，从而消除可被泄漏或钓鱼的共享秘密。该论文聚焦真实世界FIDO2部署的安全态势，指出其强安全保证依赖于客户端协议组件的良性行为。作者对实际部署进行评估，旨在发现协议实现和部署配置中可能偏离安全假设的问题。研究结果有助于理解无密码认证在真实环境中的安全边界与风险。

paper.title: Alert Alchemy: SOC Workflows and Decisions in the Management of NIDS Rules
paper.description: Signature-based network intrusion detection systems (NIDSs) and network intrusion prevention systems (NIPSs) remain at the heart of network defense, along with the rules that enable them to detect threats. These rules allow Security Operation Centers (SOCs) to properly defend a network, yet we know almost nothing about how rules are created, evaluated and managed from an organizational standpoint. In this work, we analyze the processes surrounding the creation, management, and acquisition of rules for network intrusion detection. To understand these processes, we conducted interviews with 17 professionals who work at Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) or other organizations that provide network monitoring as a service or conduct their own network monitoring internally. We discovered numerous critical factors, such as rule specificity and total number of alerts and false positives, that guide SOCs in their rule management processes. These lower-level aspects of network monitoring processes have generally been regarded as immutable by prior work, which has mainly focused on designing systems that handle the resulting alert flows by dynamically reducing the number of noisy alerts SOC analysts need to sift through. Instead, we present several recommendations that address these lower-level aspects to help improve alert quality and allow SOCs to better optimize workflows and use of available resources. These recommendations include increasing the specificity of rules, explicitly defining feedback loops from detection to rule development, and setting up organizational processes to improve the transfer of tacit knowledge.
paper.author: Mathew Vermeer, Natalia Kadenko, Michel van Eeten, Carlos Gañán, Simon Parkin
paper.summary_zh: 基于签名的网络入侵检测/防御系统是网络防御核心，其规则决定了检测能力，但规则在组织层面如何创建、评估和管理此前几乎未知。作者访谈了17名来自托管安全服务提供商或自行开展网络监控组织的专业人员，分析NIDS规则管理流程。研究发现规则特异性、告警总数和误报等关键因素会影响SOC的规则管理决策。论文据此提出建议，包括提高规则特异性、明确定义从检测到规则开发的反馈回路，以及建立组织流程以改善隐性知识转移。

paper.title: Splice: Efficiently Removing a User's Data from In-memory Application State
paper.description: Splice is a new programming framework that allows security-conscious applications to efficiently locate and delete a user's in-memory state. The core technical challenge is determining how to delete a user's memory values without breaking application-specific semantic invariants involving the memory state of remaining users. Splice solves this problem using three techniques: taint tracking (which traces how a user's data flows through memory), deletion by synthesis (which overwrites each user-owned memory value in place, replacing it with a value that preserves the symbolic constraints of enclosing data structures), and a novel type system (which forces applications to employ defensive programming to avoid computing over synthesize-deleted values in unsafe ways). Using four realistic applications that we ported to Splice, we show that Splice's type system and defensive programming requirements are not onerous for developers. We also demonstrate that Splice's run-time overheads are similar to those of prior taint tracking systems, while enabling strong deletion semantics.
paper.author: Xueyuan Han, James Mickens, Siddhartha Sen
paper.summary_zh: 许多安全敏感应用需要高效定位并删除某个用户的内存状态，但直接删除可能破坏涉及剩余用户内存值的应用语义不变量。Splice是一个新的编程框架，使用污点跟踪追踪用户数据流向，采用按合成删除原地覆盖用户拥有的内存值并保留外层数据结构的符号约束，并引入新型类型系统强制应用进行防御性编程。作者将四个真实应用移植到Splice，表明类型系统和防御性编程要求对开发者并不繁重。运行时开销与先前污点跟踪系统相似，同时支持强删除语义。

paper.title: Securely Sampling Discrete Gaussian Noise for Multi-Party Differential Privacy
paper.description: Differential Privacy (DP) is a widely used technique for protecting individuals' privacy by limiting what can be inferred about them from aggregate data. Recently, there have been efforts to implement DP using Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to achieve high utility without the need for a trusted third party. One of the key components of implementing DP in MPC is noise sampling. Our work presents the first MPC solution for sampling discrete Gaussian, a common type of noise used for constructing DP mechanisms, which plays nicely with malicious secure MPC protocols.
paper.author: Chengkun Wei, Ruijing Yu, Yuan Fan, Wenzhi Chen, Tianhao Wang
paper.summary_zh: 差分隐私通过限制从聚合数据中推断个体信息来保护隐私，近期研究利用安全多方计算（MPC）实现DP，以避免依赖可信第三方。噪声采样是在MPC中实现DP的关键组件之一。该论文提出首个用于采样离散高斯噪声的MPC解决方案，离散高斯是构造DP机制的常用噪声类型。该方案能与恶意安全MPC协议良好兼容，为多参与方DP提供安全噪声采样基础。

paper.title: PELTA - Shielding Multiparty-FHE against Malicious Adversaries
paper.description: Multiparty fully homomorphic encryption (MFHE) schemes enable multiple parties to efficiently compute functions on their sensitive data while retaining confidentiality. However, existing MFHE schemes guarantee data confidentiality and the correctness of the computation result only against honest-but-curious adversaries. In this work, we provide the first practical construction that enables the verification of MFHE operations in zero-knowledge, protecting MFHE from malicious adversaries. Our solution relies on a combination of lattice-based commitment schemes and proof systems which we adapt to support both modern FHE schemes and their implementation optimizations. We implement our construction in PELTA. Our experimental evaluation shows that PELTA is one to two orders of magnitude faster than existing techniques in the literature.
paper.author: Sylvain Chatel, Christian Mouchet, Ali Utkan Sahin, Apostolos Pyrgelis, Carmela Troncoso, Jean-Pierre Hubaux
paper.summary_zh: 多参与方全同态加密（MFHE）允许多方在保持数据机密性的同时高效计算函数，但现有方案仅在诚实但好奇敌手模型下保证机密性和计算正确性。该论文提出首个实用构造，通过零知识证明验证MFHE操作，从而抵御恶意敌手。方案结合格基承诺方案和证明系统，并适配现代FHE方案及其实现优化。实验评估显示PELTA比现有技术快一到两个数量级。

paper.title: Level Up: Private Non-Interactive Decision Tree Evaluation using Levelled Homomorphic Encryption
paper.description: As machine learning as a service continues gaining popularity, concerns about privacy and intellectual property arise. Users often hesitate to disclose their private information to obtain a service, while service providers aim to protect their proprietary models. Decision trees, a widely used machine learning model, are favoured for their simplicity, interpretability, and ease of training. In this context, Private Decision Tree Evaluation (PDTE) enables a server holding a private decision tree to provide predictions based on a client's private attributes. The protocol is such that the server learns nothing about the client's private attributes. Similarly, the client learns nothing about the server's model besides the prediction and some hyperparameters.
paper.author: Rasoul Akhavan Mahdavi, Haoyan Ni, Dimitry Linkov, Florian Kerschbaum
paper.summary_zh: 随着机器学习即服务普及，用户不愿向服务商泄露私有数据，服务商也希望保护模型知识产权，因此隐私保护推理变得重要。决策树因简单、可解释且易训练而被广泛使用。私有决策树评估（PDTE）允许服务器基于客户端私有属性提供预测，同时服务器学不到客户端属性，客户端除预测和部分超参数外学不到模型信息。论文利用分层同态加密提出一种非交互式PDTE协议。

paper.title: Provably Unlinkable Smart Card-based Payments
paper.description: The most prevalent smart card-based payment method, EMV, currently offers no privacy to its users. Transaction details and the card number are sent in cleartext, enabling the profiling and tracking of cardholders. Since public awareness of privacy issues is growing and legislation, such as GDPR, is emerging, we believe it is necessary to investigate the possibility of making payments anonymous and unlikable without compromising essential security guarantees and functional properties of EMV. This paper draws attention to trade-offs between functional and privacy requirements in the design of such a protocol. We present the UTX protocol - an enhanced payment protocol satisfying such requirements, and we formally certify key security and privacy properties using techniques based on the applied π-calculus.
paper.author: Sergiu Bursuc, Ross Horne, Sjouke Mauw, Semen Yurkov
paper.summary_zh: 当前主流智能卡支付EMV不提供用户隐私，交易细节和卡号以明文传输，导致持卡人可被画像和追踪。随着GDPR等法规出台和公众隐私意识增强，论文研究在不牺牲EMV关键安全保证和功能属性的前提下实现匿名且不可链接支付的可行性。作者提出UTX增强支付协议，并用基于应用π演算的方法形式化验证其关键安全与隐私属性。该工作还讨论了此类协议设计中功能需求与隐私需求之间的权衡。

paper.title: AISec '23: 16th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security
paper.description: The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) has been the center of the most outstanding advancements in the last years. The ability to analyze considerable streams of data in real time makes these technologies the most promising tool in many domains, including cybersecurity. As an outstanding example, ML can be used for identifying malware because of its ability to detect patterns otherwise difficult to see for humans and hard-coded rules. As malware continues to evolve, ML will become increasingly important for keeping up with the latest threats. However, the use of AI and ML in security-relevant domains raised rightful concerns about their trustworthiness and robustness, especially in front of adaptive attackers. Additionally, privacy threats are now emerging as a crucial aspect and need proper testing and possibly mitigation to prevent data stealing and leakage of sensitive information. The AISec workshop provides a venue for presenting and discussing new developments in the intersection of security and privacy with AI and ML. The complete AISec'23 workshop proceedings are available at: https://dl.acm.org/doi/proceedings/10.1145/3576915.3624029.
paper.author: Maura Pintor, Florian Simon Tramèr, Xinyun Chen
paper.summary_zh: 该文是AISec'23第16届ACM人工智能与安全研讨会的介绍。AI/ML在安全领域（如恶意软件检测）展现出强大能力，但也引发对其可信性、鲁棒性以及隐私威胁的担忧，尤其是在自适应攻击者面前。研讨会为安全与隐私同AI/ML交叉领域的新进展提供交流平台。

paper.title: martFL: Enabling Utility-Driven Data Marketplace with a Robust and Verifiable Federated Learning Architecture
paper.description: The development of machine learning models requires a large amount of training data. Data marketplace is a critical platform to trade high-quality and private-domain data that is not publicly available on the Internet. However, as data privacy becomes increasingly important, directly exchanging raw data becomes inappropriate. Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning paradigm that exchanges data utilities (in form of local models or gradients) among multiple parties without directly sharing the original data. However, we recognize several key challenges in applying existing FL architectures to construct a data marketplace. (i) In existing FL architectures, the Data Acquirer (DA) cannot privately assess the quality of local models submitted by different Data Providers (DPs) prior to trading; (ii)The model aggregation protocols in existing FL designs cannot effectively exclude malicious DPs without "overfitting'' to the DA's (possibly biased) root dataset; (iii) Prior FL designs lack a proper billing mechanism to enforce the DA to fairly allocate the reward according to contributions made by different DPs. To address above challenges, we propose martFL, the first federated learning architecture that is specifically designed to enable a secure utility-driven data marketplace. At a high level, martFL is empowered by two innovative designs: (i) a quality-aware model aggregation protocol that allows the DA to properly exclude local-quality or even poisonous local models from the aggregation, even if the DA's root dataset is biased; (ii) a verifiable data transaction protocol that enables the DA to prove, both succinctly and in zero-knowledge, that it has faithfully aggregated these local models according to the weights that the DA has committed to. This enables the DPs to unambiguously claim the rewards proportional to their weights/contributions. We implement a prototype of martFL and evaluate it extensively over various tasks. The results show that martFL can improve the model accuracy by up to 25% while saving up to 64% data acquisition cost.
paper.author: Qi Li, Zhuotao Liu, Qi Li, Ke Xu
paper.summary_zh: 数据市场需要高质量训练数据，但直接交换原始数据会带来隐私问题；联邦学习通过交换本地模型或梯度而不共享原始数据，为数据交易提供了新思路。现有FL架构用于数据市场时存在三个挑战：数据获取方无法在交易前私下评估各数据提供方模型质量，聚合协议难以在不偏向根数据集的情况下排除恶意提供方，且缺乏公平计费机制。为此作者提出martFL，首个面向效用驱动数据市场的安全联邦学习架构，包含质量感知模型聚合协议和可验证数据交易协议（利用零知识证明验证聚合权重）。实验表明martFL可将模型准确率最多提升25%，同时节省最多64%的数据获取成本。

paper.title: Unraveling the Connections between Privacy and Certified Robustness in Federated Learning Against Poisoning Attacks
paper.description: Federated learning (FL) provides an efficient paradigm to jointly train a global model leveraging data from distributed users. As local training data comes from different users who may not be trustworthy, several studies have shown that FL is vulnerable to poisoning attacks. Meanwhile, to protect the privacy of local users, FL is usually trained in a differentially private way (DPFL). Thus, in this paper, we ask: What are the underlying connections between differential privacy and certified robustness in FL against poisoning attacks? Can we leverage the innate privacy property of DPFL to provide certified robustness for FL? Can we further improve the privacy of FL to improve such robustness certification? We first investigate both user-level and instance-level privacy of FL and provide formal privacy analysis to achieve improved instance-level privacy. We then provide two robustness certification criteria: certified prediction and certified attack inefficacy for DPFL on both user and instance levels. Theoretically, we provide the certified robustness of DPFL based on both criteria given a bounded number of adversarial users or instances. Empirically, we conduct extensive experiments to verify our theories under a range of poisoning attacks on different datasets. We find that increasing the level of privacy protection in DPFL results in stronger certified attack inefficacy; however, it does not necessarily lead to a stronger certified prediction. Thus, achieving the optimal certified prediction requires a proper balance between privacy and utility loss.
paper.author: Chulin Xie, Yunhui Long, Pin-Yu Chen, Qinbin Li, Sanmi Koyejo, Bo Li
paper.summary_zh: 联邦学习利用分布式用户数据联合训练全局模型，但本地数据可能不可信，因此易受投毒攻击；同时常采用差分隐私（DPFL）保护用户隐私。论文研究DP与FL抗投毒认证鲁棒性之间的联系，分析用户级和实例级隐私并提供改进实例级隐私的形式化分析。作者提出两个鲁棒性认证标准：认证预测和认证攻击无效性，并在有界恶意用户或实例数量下给出理论保证。实验发现增强DPFL隐私保护会带来更强的认证攻击无效性，但不一定带来更强的认证预测，最优认证预测需要在隐私和效用损失之间取得平衡。

paper.title: "We've Disabled MFA for You": An Evaluation of the Security and Usability of Multi-Factor Authentication Recovery Deployments
paper.description: Multi-Factor Authentication is intended to strengthen the security of password-based authentication by adding another factor, such as hardware tokens or one-time passwords using mobile apps.
paper.author: Sabrina Klivan, Sandra Höltervennhoff, Nicolas Huaman, Alexander Krause, Lucy Simko, Yasemin Acar, Sascha Fahl
paper.summary_zh: 多因素认证通过在密码之外增加硬件令牌或移动应用一次性密码等因素来增强认证安全。然而，MFA恢复部署可能引入新的安全与可用性风险，例如在账户恢复时绕过或禁用MFA。该论文评估多因素认证恢复部署的安全性和可用性，关注不同恢复机制如何影响整体防护效果。研究有助于理解MFA恢复流程中的设计缺陷和用户风险。

paper.title: Sharing Communities: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
paper.description: There are many mysteries surrounding sharing communities, mainly due to their hidden workings and the complexity of joining.
