Nevertheless, these communities are critical to the security ecosystem, so a more profound understanding is necessary. In addition, they face challenges such as building trust, communicating effectively, and addressing social problems.
paper.author: Thomas Geras, Thomas Schreck
paper.summary_zh: 共享社区对安全生态至关重要，但其内部运作隐秘、加入过程复杂，外界对其了解有限。论文关注这些社区面临的信任建立、有效沟通和社会问题等挑战。研究分析了共享社区的好、坏与丑陋面，旨在提供更深入的理解。

paper.title: Jack-in-the-box: An Empirical Study of JavaScript Bundling on the Web and its Security Implications
paper.description: In recent years, we have seen an increased interest in studying the software supply chain of user-facing applications to uncover problematic third-party dependencies. Prior work shows that web applications often rely on outdated or vulnerable third-party code. Moreover, real-world supply chain attacks show that dependencies can also be used to deliver malicious code, e.g., for carrying cryptomining operations. Nonetheless, existing measurement studies in this domain neglect an important software engineering practice: developers often merge together third-party code into a single file called bundle, which they then deliver from their own servers, making it appear as first-party code. Bundlers like Webpack or Rollup are popular open-source projects with tens of thousand of GitHub stars, suggesting that this technology is widely-used by developers. Ignoring bundling may result in underestimating the complexity of modern software supply chains.
paper.author: Jeremy Rack, Cristian-Alexandru Staicu
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注 Web 应用软件供应链中常被忽视的 JavaScript 打包实践：开发者将大量第三方依赖合并为 bundle，并由自己的服务器以第一方代码形式提供给用户。作者对 Web 上的 JavaScript 打包进行实证研究，分析 Webpack、Rollup 等打包器被广泛使用后，第三方代码如何被隐藏和整合。研究指出忽略 bundling 会导致低估现代软件供应链的复杂性，并使过时依赖、漏洞依赖甚至恶意代码更难被识别。

paper.title: IoTFlow: Inferring IoT Device Behavior at Scale through Static Mobile Companion App Analysis
paper.description: The number of "smart'' devices, that is, devices making up the Internet of Things (IoT), is steadily growing. They suffer from vulnerabilities just as other software and hardware. Automated analysis techniques can detect and address weaknesses before attackers can misuse them. Applying existing techniques or developing new approaches that are sufficiently general is challenging though. Contrary to other platforms, the IoT ecosystem features various software and hardware architectures.
paper.author: David Schmidt, Carlotta Tagliaro, Kevin Borgolte, Martina Lindorfer
paper.summary_zh: IoT 智能设备数量持续增长且同样存在漏洞，自动分析技术可在攻击者利用前发现弱点，但 IoT 生态软硬件架构多样，通用分析非常困难。论文提出 IoTFlow，通过静态分析移动伴侣应用来大规模推断 IoT 设备行为。该方法利用手机 App 与设备交互的信息推断设备能力与行为，为跨架构 IoT 设备的自动化安全分析提供基础。

paper.title: DSFuzz: Detecting Deep State Bugs with Dependent State Exploration
paper.description: Traditional random mutation-based fuzzers are ineffective at reaching deep program states that require specific input values. Consequently, a large number of deep bugs remain undiscovered. To enhance the effectiveness of input mutation, previous research has utilized taint analysis to identify control-dependent critical bytes and only mutates those bytes. However, existing works do not consider indirect control dependencies, in which the critical bytes for taking one branch can only be set in a basic block that is control dependent on a series of other basic blocks. These critical bytes cannot be identified unless that series of basic blocks are visited in the execution path. Existing approaches would take an unacceptably long time and computation resources to attempt multiple paths before setting these critical bytes. In other words, the search space for identifying the critical bytes cannot be effectively explored by the current mutation strategies.
paper.author: Yinxi Liu, Wei Meng
paper.summary_zh: 传统基于随机变异的 fuzzer 难以到达需要特定输入值的深层程序状态，导致大量深层漏洞未被发现。已有工作利用污点分析识别控制依赖的关键字节并只变异这些字节，但忽略了间接控制依赖：触发某分支的关键字节可能只能在受一系列其他基本块控制的代码块中设置。论文提出 DSFuzz，通过依赖状态探索来检测深层状态漏洞，有效探索识别关键字节所需的搜索空间，从而提升深层 bug 的发现能力。

paper.title: A Generic Methodology for the Modular Verification of Security Protocol Implementations
paper.description: Security protocols are essential building blocks of modern IT systems. Subtle flaws in their design or implementation may compromise the security of entire systems. It is, thus, important to prove the absence of such flaws through formal verification. Much existing work focuses on the verification of protocol models, which is not sufficient to show that their implementations are actually secure. Verification techniques for protocol implementations (e.g., via code generation or model extraction) typically impose severe restrictions on the used programming language and code design, which may lead to sub-optimal implementations. In this paper, we present a methodology for the modular verification of strong security properties directly on the level of the protocol implementations. Our methodology leverages state-of-the-art verification logics and tools to support a wide range of implementations and programming languages. We demonstrate its effectiveness by verifying memory safety and security of Go implementations of the Needham-Schroeder-Lowe, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and WireGuard protocols, including forward secrecy and injective agreement for WireGuard. We also show that our methodology is agnostic to a particular language or program verifier with a prototype implementation for C.
paper.author: Linard Arquint, Malte Schwerhoff, Vaibhav Mehta, Peter Müller
paper.summary_zh: 安全协议是现代 IT 系统的关键组件，设计或实现中的细微缺陷可能危及整个系统，但已有工作多验证协议模型，或对实现验证施加严格的语言与代码设计限制。论文提出一种在协议实现层面进行模块化验证的方法，利用现代验证逻辑与工具支持多种实现和编程语言。作者用 Go 实现的 Needham-Schroeder-Lowe、Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 WireGuard 验证内存安全与安全性，包括 WireGuard 的前向保密和单射一致性，并用 C 原型表明方法不依赖特定语言或验证器。

paper.title: AIM: Symmetric Primitive for Shorter Signatures with Stronger Security
paper.description: Post-quantum signature schemes based on the MPC-in-the-Head (MPCitH) paradigm are recently attracting significant attention as their security solely depends on the one-wayness of the underlying primitive, providing diversity for the hardness assumption in post-quantum cryptography. Recent MPCitH-friendly ciphers have been designed using simple algebraic S-boxes operating on a large field in order to improve the performance of the resulting signature schemes. Due to their simple algebraic structures, their security against algebraic attacks should be comprehensively studied.
paper.author: Seongkwang Kim, Jincheol Ha, Mincheol Son, Byeonghak Lee, Dukjae Moon, Joohee Lee, Sangyub Lee, Jihoon Kwon, Jihoon Cho, Hyojin Yoon, Jooyoung Lee
paper.summary_zh: 基于 MPC-in-the-Head 的后量子签名方案因安全性仅依赖底层原语的单向性而受到关注，为后量子密码的困难假设提供了多样性。近期 MPCitH-friendly 密码使用大域上的简单代数 S-box 来提升签名方案性能，但其简单代数结构使其抗代数攻击安全性需要被全面研究。论文提出 AIM 对称原语，目标是在更强安全性下构造更短的签名，并强调对这类密码进行代数攻击安全性分析的重要性。

paper.title: LedgerLocks: A Security Framework for Blockchain Protocols Based on Adaptor Signatures
paper.description: The scalability and interoperability challenges in current cryptocurrencies have motivated the design of cryptographic protocols that enable efficient applications on top and across widely used cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin or Ethereum. Examples of such protocols include (virtual) payment channels, atomic swaps, oracle-based contracts, deterministic wallets, and coin mixing services. Many of these protocols are built upon minimal core functionalities supported by a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Most prominently, adaptor signatures (AS) have emerged as a powerful tool for constructing blockchain protocols that are (mostly) agnostic to the specific logic of the underlying cryptocurrency. Even though AS-based protocols are built upon the same cryptographic principles, there exists no modular and faithful way for reasoning about their security. Instead, all the works analyzing such protocols focus on reproving how adaptor signatures are used to cryptographically link transactions while considering highly simplified blockchain models that do not capture security-relevant aspects of transaction execution in blockchain-based consensus.
paper.author: Erkan Tairi, Pedro Moreno-Sanchez, Clara Schneidewind
paper.summary_zh: 加密货币的可扩展性与互操作性需求推动了基于 Bitcoin、Ethereum 等链的密码协议，如支付通道、原子交换、预言机合约、确定性钱包和混币服务，其中适配器签名是关键工具。尽管 AS 协议基于共同密码学原理，但缺乏模块化且忠实的安全推理方法，已有分析多在简化区块链模型下重新证明交易链接。论文提出 LedgerLocks 安全框架，用于基于适配器签名的区块链协议安全分析，并考虑区块链共识中交易执行的安全相关方面。

paper.title: Adaptively Secure (Aggregatable) PVSS and Application to Distributed Randomness Beacons
paper.description: Publicly Verifiable Secret Sharing (PVSS) is a fundamental primitive that allows to share a secret S among n parties via a publicly verifiable transcript T. Existing (efficient) PVSS are only proven secure against static adversaries who must choose who to corrupt ahead of a protocol execution. As a result, any protocol (e.g., a distributed randomness beacon) that builds on top of such a PVSS scheme inherits this limitation. To overcome this barrier, we revisit the security of PVSS under adaptive corruptions and show that, surprisingly, many protocols from the literature already achieve it in a meaningful way:
paper.author: Renas Bacho, Julian Loss
paper.summary_zh: 公开可验证秘密共享是允许 n 方通过公开可验证记录共享秘密的基础原语，但现有高效 PVSS 仅能证明抵御静态敌手，导致分布式随机信标等上层协议继承该限制。论文重新审视自适应腐化下的 PVSS 安全性，发现文献中许多协议已在有意义的方式下实现自适应安全。作者进一步研究可聚合 PVSS，并将其应用于分布式随机性信标，以提升其在自适应敌手模型下的安全性。

paper.title: Demystifying DeFi MEV Activities in Flashbots Bundle
paper.description: Decentralized Finance, mushrooming in permissionless blockchains, has attracted a recent surge in popularity. Due to the transparency of permissionless blockchains, opportunistic traders can compete to earn revenue by extracting Miner Extractable Value (MEV), which undermines both the consensus security and efficiency of blockchain systems. The Flashbots bundle mechanism further aggravates the MEV competition because it empowers opportunistic traders with the capability of designing more sophisticated MEV extraction. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic study on DeFi MEV activities in Flashbots bundle by developing ActLifter, a novel automated tool for accurately identifying DeFi actions in transactions of each bundle, and ActCluster, a new approach that leverages iterative clustering to facilitate us to discover known/unknown DeFi MEV activities. Extensive experimental results show that ActLifter can achieve nearly 100% precision and recall in DeFi action identification, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art techniques. Moreover, with the help of ActCluster, we obtain many new observations and discover 17 new kinds of DeFi MEV activities, which occur in 53.12% of bundles but have not been reported in existing studies.
paper.author: Zihao Li, Jianfeng Li, Zheyuan He, Xiapu Luo, Ting Wang, Xiaoze Ni, Wenwu Yang, Xi Chen, Ting Chen
paper.summary_zh: 去中心化金融在无许可区块链上迅速发展，由于链上透明性，机会主义交易者通过提取矿工可提取价值获利，损害区块链共识安全与效率，而 Flashbots bundle 机制进一步加剧了 MEV 竞争。论文首次系统研究 Flashbots bundle 中的 DeFi MEV 活动，提出 ActLifter 自动识别每笔 bundle 交易中的 DeFi 操作，以及 ActCluster 利用迭代聚类发现已知和未知 DeFi MEV 活动。实验显示 ActLifter 在 DeFi 动作识别上接近 100% 精确率和召回率，并发现 17 种新 MEV 活动，出现在 53.12% 的 bundle 中且此前未被报道。

paper.title: Concurrent Composition for Interactive Differential Privacy with Adaptive Privacy-Loss Parameters
paper.description: In this paper, we study the concurrent composition of interactive mechanisms with adaptively chosen privacy-loss parameters. In this setting, the adversary can interleave queries to existing interactive mechanisms, as well as create new ones. We prove that every valid privacy filter and odometer for noninteractive mechanisms extends to the concurrent composition of interactive mechanisms if privacy loss is measured using (ε, δ)-DP, ƒ-DP, or Rényi DP of fixed order. Our results offer strong theoretical foundations for enabling full adaptivity in composing differentially private interactive mechanisms, showing that concurrency does not affect the privacy guarantees. We also provide an implementation for users to deploy in practice.
paper.author: Samuel Haney, Michael Shoemate, Grace Tian, Salil Vadhan, Andrew Vyrros, Vicki Xu, Wanrong Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究带自适应隐私损失参数的交互式差分隐私机制的并发组合问题。在此设置中，对手可以交错查询已有交互机制并创建新机制；作者证明若隐私损失用 (ε,δ)-DP、f-DP 或固定阶 Rényi DP 度量，非交互机制的有效 privacy filter 和 odometer 可扩展到交互机制的并发组合。结果表明并发不会影响隐私保证，为交互式差分隐私机制的完全自适应性提供理论基础，并提供可供实际部署的实现。

paper.title: MESAS: Poisoning Defense for Federated Learning Resilient against Adaptive Attackers
paper.description: Federated Learning (FL) enhances decentralized machine learning by safeguarding data privacy, reducing communication costs, and improving model performance with diverse data sources. However, FL faces vulnerabilities such as untargeted poisoning attacks and targeted backdoor attacks, posing challenges to model integrity and security. Preventing backdoors proves especially challenging due to their stealthy nature. Existing mitigation techniques have shown efficacy but often overlook realistic adversaries and diverse data distributions.
paper.author: Torsten Krauß, Alexandra Dmitrienko
paper.summary_zh: 联邦学习能增强去中心化机器学习的数据隐私、降低通信成本并利用多样数据提升模型性能，但面临无目标投毒攻击和定向后门攻击，后门因隐蔽性尤其难以防御。现有缓解方法虽有效，却常忽略现实中的自适应攻击者和多样数据分布。论文提出 MESAS 投毒防御框架，旨在对自适应攻击者保持鲁棒，并在真实威胁模型和非独立同分布数据下提升联邦学习模型的完整性。

paper.title: TypeSqueezer: When Static Recovery of Function Signatures for Binary Executables Meets Dynamic Analysis
paper.description: Control-Flow Integrity (CFI) is considered a promising solution in thwarting advanced code-reuse attacks. While the problem of backward-edge protection in CFI is nearly closed, effective forward-edge protection is still a major challenge. The keystone of protecting the forward edge is to resolve indirect call targets, which although can be done quite accurately using type-based solutions given the program source code, it faces difficulties when carried out at the binary level. Since the actual type information is unavailable in COTS binaries, type-based indirect call target matching typically resorts to approximate function signatures inferred using the arity and argument width of indirect callsites and calltargets. Doing so with static analysis, therefore, forces the existing solutions to assume the arity/width boundaries in a too-permissive way to defeat sophisticated attacks.
paper.author: Ziyi Lin, Jinku Li, Bowen Li, Haoyu Ma, Debin Gao, Jianfeng Ma
paper.summary_zh: 控制流完整性是抵御高级代码复用攻击的有效方案，但后向边保护已较成熟，前向边保护仍是重大挑战，其核心是解析间接调用目标。在二进制层面，COTS 程序缺少实际类型信息，基于类型的间接调用目标匹配只能依赖由调用点和目标的数量及参数宽度近似推断的函数签名，静态分析往往被迫采用过度宽松的边界，难以防御复杂攻击。论文提出 TypeSqueezer，将二进制可执行文件函数签名的静态恢复与动态分析结合，以更精确地恢复函数签名并增强前向边 CFI 保护。

paper.title: PLAS: The 18th Workshop on Programming Languages and Analysis for Security
paper.description: PLAS provides a forum for exploring and evaluating the use of programming language and program analysis techniques for promoting security in the complete range of software systems, from compilers to machine-learned models and smart contracts. The workshop encourages proposals of new, speculative ideas, evaluations of new or known techniques in practical settings, and discussions of emerging threats and problems. We also host position papers that are radical, forward-looking, and lead to lively and insightful discussions influential to future research at the intersection of programming languages and security. This year will mark the 18th iteration of PLAS, which was first held in 2007 in San Diego. We expect an exciting program and many interesting discussions.
paper.author: Fraser Brown, Klaus v. Gleissenthall
paper.summary_zh: 这是第 18 届 Programming Languages and Analysis for Security 研讨会的介绍，而非一篇完整研究论文。PLAS 为利用编程语言和程序分析技术提升软件系统安全提供交流平台，范围涵盖编译器、机器学习模型和智能合约等。该届研讨会鼓励提出新想法、在实际环境中评估技术，并讨论新兴威胁与问题，同时也接受具有前瞻性的立场论文，以促进编程语言与安全交叉领域的研究交流。

paper.title: Tainted Secure Multi-Execution to Restrict Attacker Influence
paper.description: Attackers can steal sensitive user information from web pages via third-party scripts. Prior work shows that secure multi-execution (SME) with declassification is useful for mitigating such attacks, but that attackers can leverage dynamic web features to declassify more than intended. The proposed solution of disallowing events from dynamic web elements to be declassified is too restrictive to be practical; websites that declassify events from dynamic elements cannot function correctly.
paper.author: McKenna McCall, Abhishek Bichhawat, Limin Jia
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究第三方脚本通过网页窃取用户敏感信息的问题，并指出带解密的 secure multi-execution（SME）虽能缓解此类攻击，但攻击者可利用动态网页特性过度解密。此前提出的禁止动态网页元素事件解密方案又过于严格，会导致网站功能无法正常工作。作者提出 Tainted Secure Multi-Execution，通过污点跟踪限制攻击者影响，在安全性与网页可用性之间取得更实用的平衡。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但核心贡献是改进动态网页场景下的 SME 解密控制。

paper.title: Understanding and Detecting Abused Image Hosting Modules as Malicious Services
paper.description: As a new type of underground ecosystem, the exploitation of Abused IHMs as MalIcious sErvices (AIMIEs) is becoming increasingly prevalent among miscreants to host illegal images and propagate harmful content. However, there has been little effort to understand this new menace, in terms of its magnitude, impact, and techniques, not to mention any serious effort to detect vulnerable image hosting modules on a large scale. To fulfill this gap, this paper presents the first measurement study of AIMIEs. By collecting and analyzing 89 open-sourced AIMIEs, we reveal the landscape of AIMIEs, report the evolution and evasiveness of abused image hosting APIs from reputable companies such as Alibaba, Tencent, and Bytedance, and identify real-world abused images uploaded through those AIMIEs. In addition, we propose a tool, called Viola, to detect vulnerable image hosting modules (IHMs) in the wild. We find 477 vulnerable IHM upload APIs associated with 338 web services, which integrated vulnerable IHMs, and 207 victim FQDNs. The highest-ranked domain with vulnerable web service is baidu.com, followed by bilibili.com and 163.com. We have reported abused and vulnerable IHM upload APIs and received acknowledgments from 69 of them by the time of paper submission.
paper.author: Geng Hong, Mengying Wu, Pei Chen, Xiaojing Liao, Guoyi Ye, Min Yang
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注一种新型地下生态：攻击者滥用图片托管模块（IHM）作为恶意服务（AIMIE），用于托管非法图片和传播有害内容。现有工作对这种威胁的规模、影响和技术手段缺乏系统理解，也缺少大规模检测脆弱 IHM 的方法。作者首次对 AIMIE 进行测量研究，收集并分析 89 个开源 AIMIE，揭示其生态、来自阿里巴巴、腾讯、字节跳动等公司的被滥用图片托管 API 的演化与规避方式，并识别真实被滥用图片。论文还提出检测工具 Viola，在野发现 477 个脆弱 IHM 上传 API，关联 338 个 Web 服务和 207 个受害 FQDN，最高排名域名为 baidu.com，其次是 bilibili.com 和 163.com，并已向相关方报告且获得 69 个确认。

paper.title: Hopper: Interpretative Fuzzing for Libraries
paper.description: Despite the fact that the state-of-the-art fuzzers can generate inputs efficiently, existing fuzz drivers still cannot adequately cover entries in libraries. Most of these fuzz drivers are crafted manually by developers, and their quality depends on the developers' understanding of the code. Existing works have attempted to automate the generation of fuzz drivers by learning API usage from code and execution traces. However, the generated fuzz drivers are limited to a few specific call sequences by the code being learned. To address these challenges, we present HOPPER, which can fuzz libraries without requiring any domain knowledge to craft fuzz drivers. It transforms the problem of library fuzzing into the problem of interpreter fuzzing. The interpreters linked against libraries under test can interpret the inputs that describe arbitrary API usage. To generate semantically correct inputs for the interpreter, HOPPER learns the intra-and inter-API constraints in the libraries and mutates the program with grammar awareness. We implemented HOPPER and evaluated its effectiveness on 11 real-world libraries against manually crafted fuzzers and other automatic solutions. Our results show that HOPPER greatly outperformed the other fuzzers in both code coverage and bug finding, having uncovered 25 previously unknown bugs that other fuzzers couldn't. Moreover, we have demonstrated that the proposed intra- and inter-API constraint learning methods can correctly learn constraints implied by the library and, therefore, significantly improve the fuzzing efficiency. The experiment results indicate that HOPPER is able to explore a vast range of API usages for library fuzzing out of the box.
paper.author: Peng Chen, Yuxuan Xie, Yunlong Lyu, Yuxiao Wang, Hao Chen
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对现有 fuzzer 虽能高效生成输入，但 fuzz driver 仍难以充分覆盖库入口的问题。多数 fuzz driver 由开发者手工编写，质量依赖其对代码的理解；已有自动生成方法又受学习到的调用序列限制，难以探索任意 API 用法。作者提出 HOPPER，将库模糊测试转化为解释器模糊测试：链接被测库的解释器可以解释描述任意 API 用法的输入。为生成语义正确的解释器输入，HOPPER 学习库内 API 内部及 API 之间的约束，并进行语法感知变异。论文在 11 个真实库上评估，显示其在代码覆盖和漏洞发现上显著优于其他 fuzzer，并发现 25 个此前未知漏洞。

paper.title: HODOR: Shrinking Attack Surface on Node.js via System Call Limitation
paper.description: Node.js applications are becoming more and more widely adopted on the server side, partly due to the convenience of building these applications on top of the runtime provided by popular Node.js engines and the large number of third-party packages provided by the Node Package Management (npm) registry. Node.js provides Node.js applications with system interaction capabilities using system calls. However, such convenience comes with a price, i.e., the attack surface of JavaScript arbitrary code execution (ACE) vulnerabilities is expanded to the system call level.
paper.author: Wenya Wang, Xingwei Lin, Jingyi Wang, Wang Gao, Dawu Gu, Wei Lv, Jiashui Wang
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注 Node.js 应用在服务端广泛使用后带来的安全风险：Node.js 通过系统调用提供系统交互能力，这使得 JavaScript 任意代码执行漏洞的攻击面扩展到了系统调用层。一旦攻击者利用第三方包或运行时漏洞执行任意 JavaScript，就可能进一步发起危险系统调用。作者提出 HODOR，通过限制 Node.js 应用可用的系统调用来缩小攻击面。摘要未给出定量实验结果，但核心思路是在系统调用层面实施限制，以降低任意代码执行漏洞的危害。

paper.title: Declassiflow: A Static Analysis for Modeling Non-Speculative Knowledge to Relax Speculative Execution Security Measures
paper.description: Speculative execution attacks undermine the security of constant-time programming, the standard technique used to prevent microarchitectural side channels in security-sensitive software such as cryptographic code. Constant-time code must therefore also deploy a defense against speculative execution attacks to prevent leakage of secret data stored in memory or the processor registers. Unfortunately, contemporary defenses, such as speculative load hardening (SLH), can only satisfy this strong security guarantee at a very high performance cost.
paper.author: Rutvik Choudhary, Alan Wang, Zirui Neil Zhao, Adam Morrison, Christopher W. Fletcher
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注推测执行攻击对常量时间编程的破坏：常量时间代码本用于防止微架构侧信道，但还必须额外防御推测执行攻击，以避免泄露内存或寄存器中的秘密。现有防御如 speculative load hardening（SLH）虽能满足强安全保证，却带来很高的性能开销。作者提出 Declassiflow，一种静态分析技术，通过建模“非推测知识”来放宽推测执行安全防护范围。其目标是在不牺牲必要安全性的前提下，减少需要强防护的代码区域，从而降低性能代价。摘要未给出具体实验数据。

paper.title: Modular Sumcheck Proofs with Applications to Machine Learning and Image Processing
paper.description: Cryptographic proof systems provide integrity, fairness, and privacy in applications that outsource data processing tasks. However, general-purpose proof systems do not scale well to large inputs. At the same time, ad-hoc solutions for concrete applications - e.g., machine learning or image processing - are more efficient but lack modularity, hence they are hard to extend or to compose with other tools of a data-processing pipeline.
paper.author: David Balbás, Dario Fiore, Maria Isabel González Vasco, Damien Robissout, Claudio Soriente
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究外包数据处理中的密码学证明系统：通用证明系统难以扩展到大规模输入，而针对机器学习或图像处理等具体应用的专用方案虽然高效，却缺乏模块化和可组合性。作者提出模块化的 sumcheck 证明，使数据流水线中的不同组件可以更容易地扩展和组合。该方法面向机器学习与图像处理等场景，旨在兼顾证明效率与系统模块化。摘要未给出具体性能结果，但核心贡献是提升证明系统在大规模外包计算中的可组合性。

paper.title: Homomorphic Multiple Precision Multiplication for CKKS and Reduced Modulus Consumption
paper.description: Homomorphic Encryption (HE) schemes such as BGV, BFV, and CKKS consume some ciphertext modulus for each multiplication. Bootstrapping (BTS) restores the modulus and allows homomorphic computation to continue, but it is time-consuming and requires a significant amount of modulus. For these reasons, decreasing modulus consumption is crucial topic for BGV, BFV and CKKS, on which numerous studies have been conducted.
paper.author: Jung Hee Cheon, Wonhee Cho, Jaehyung Kim, Damien Stehlé
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注 BGV、BFV、CKKS 等同态加密方案中每次乘法都会消耗密文模数的问题。Bootstrapping 虽可恢复模数并继续同态计算，但耗时长且需要大量模数，因此降低模数消耗非常关键。作者提出面向 CKKS 的同态多精度乘法技术，以减少模数消耗。该工作旨在延长可用乘法深度或减少对 bootstrapping 的依赖，从而提升同态加密计算的实用性。摘要未给出具体基准数据。

paper.title: Themis: Fast, Strong Order-Fairness in Byzantine Consensus
paper.description: We introduce Themis, a scheme for introducing fair ordering of transactions into (permissioned) Byzantine consensus protocols with at most ƒ faulty nodes among n ≥ 4ƒ + 1. Themis enforces the strongest notion of fair ordering proposed to date. It also achieves standard liveness, rather than the weaker notion of previous work with the same fair ordering property.
paper.author: Mahimna Kelkar, Soubhik Deb, Sishan Long, Ari Juels, Sreeram Kannan
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究许可型拜占庭共识协议中的交易排序公平性问题。作者提出 Themis，在 n ≥ 4f + 1 且至多 f 个故障节点的条件下，为交易引入公平排序。Themis 实现了目前最强的公平排序定义，同时保持标准活性，而此前具有同等公平排序性质的工作只能提供较弱的活性保证。该方案旨在提升 Byzantine 共识中排序公平性的强度与实用性。摘要未给出具体性能数字。

paper.title: ELEKTRA: Efficient Lightweight multi-dEvice Key TRAnsparency
paper.description: Key Transparency (KT) systems enable service providers of end-to-end encrypted communication (E2EE) platforms to maintain a Verifiable Key Directory (VKD) that maps each user's identifier, such as a username or email address, to their identity public key(s). Users periodically monitor the directory to ensure their own identifier maps to the correct keys, thus detecting any attempt to register a fake key on their behalf to Meddler-in-the-Middle (MitM) their communications.
paper.author: Julia Len, Melissa Chase, Esha Ghosh, Daniel Jost, Balachandar Kesavan, Antonio Marcedone
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注端到端加密平台中的密钥透明（KT）系统：服务提供商需要维护可验证密钥目录（VKD），将用户名或邮箱等标识映射到身份公钥。用户定期监控目录，以确保自己的标识对应正确公钥，从而检测冒名注册和中间人攻击。作者提出 ELEKTRA，一种面向多设备场景的高效轻量级密钥透明方案。其目标是提升 KT 在多设备环境下的效率与可用性。摘要未给出具体性能数据。

paper.title: PolicyChecker: Analyzing the GDPR Completeness of Mobile Apps' Privacy Policies
paper.description: The European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) mandates a data controller (e.g., an app developer) to provide all information specified in Articles (Arts.) 13 and 14 to data subjects (e.g., app users) regarding how their data are being processed and what are their rights. While some studies have started to detect the fulfillment of GDPR requirements in a privacy policy, their exploration only focused on a subset of mandatory GDPR requirements. In this paper, our goal is to explore the state of GDPR-completeness violations in mobile apps' privacy policies. To achieve our goal, we design the PolicyChecker framework by taking a rule and semantic role based approach. PolicyChecker automatically detects completeness violations in privacy policies based not only on all mandatory GDPR requirements but also on all if-applicable GDPR requirements that will become mandatory under specific conditions. Using PolicyChecker, we conduct the first large-scale GDPR-completeness violation study on 205,973 privacy policies of Android apps in the UK Google Play store. PolicyChecker identified 163,068 (79.2%) privacy policies containing data collection statements; therefore, such policies are regulated by GDPR requirements. However, the majority (99.3%) of them failed to achieve the GDPR-completeness with at least one unsatisfied requirement; 98.1% of them had at least one unsatisfied mandatory requirement, while 73.0% of them had at least one unsatisfied if-applicable requirement logic chain. We conjecture that controllers' lack of understanding of some GDPR requirements and their poor practices in composing a privacy policy can be the potential major causes behind the GDPR-completeness violations. We further discuss recommendations for app developers to improve the completeness of their apps' privacy policies to provide a more transparent personal data processing environment to users.
paper.author: Anhao Xiang, Weiping Pei, Chuan Yue
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注移动应用隐私政策是否符合 GDPR 第 13、14 条要求，即数据控制者是否完整披露数据处理方式和用户权利。现有研究通常只检测部分强制要求，作者提出 PolicyChecker 框架，采用规则和语义角色相结合的方法，自动检测隐私政策在全部强制要求以及条件适用要求上的完整性违规。论文对英国 Google Play 商店中 205,973 个 Android 应用隐私政策进行了首次大规模研究，发现 163,068 个（79.2%）包含数据收集声明并受 GDPR 约束。其中绝大多数（99.3%）至少违反一项完整性要求，98.1% 至少违反一项强制要求，73.0% 至少违反一项条件适用要求逻辑链。作者进一步讨论了应用开发者改进隐私政策完整性的建议。

paper.title: DP-Forward: Fine-tuning and Inference on Language Models with Differential Privacy in Forward Pass
paper.description: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) adds noise to gradients in back-propagation, safeguarding training data from privacy leakage, particularly membership inference. It fails to cover (inference-time) threats like embedding inversion and sensitive attribute inference. It is also costly in storage and computation when used to fine-tune large pre-trained language models (LMs).
paper.author: Minxin Du, Xiang Yue, Sherman S. M. Chow, Tianhao Wang, Chenyu Huang, Huan Sun
paper.summary_zh: 论文指出差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）通过在反向传播中向梯度加噪来保护训练数据，尤其防范成员推断攻击。但 DP-SGD 无法覆盖推理阶段的嵌入反演和敏感属性推断等威胁，而且在微调大型预训练语言模型时存储和计算开销较高。作者提出 DP-Forward，在前向传播中引入差分隐私噪声，使微调和推理都能获得隐私保护。该方法旨在覆盖训练与推理阶段的泄露风险，并降低大语言模型隐私微调的成本。摘要未给出具体实验数据。

paper.title: Narcissus: A Practical Clean-Label Backdoor Attack with Limited Information
paper.description: Backdoor attacks introduce manipulated data into a machine learning model's training set, causing the model to misclassify inputs with a trigger during testing to achieve a desired outcome by the attacker. For backdoor attacks to bypass human inspection, it is essential that the injected data appear to be correctly labeled. The attacks with such property are often referred to as "clean-label attacks." The success of current clean-label backdoor methods largely depends on access to the complete training set. Yet, accessing the complete dataset is often challenging or unfeasible since it frequently comes from varied, independent sources, like images from distinct users. It remains a question of whether backdoor attacks still present real threats.
paper.author: Yi Zeng, Minzhou Pan, Hoang Anh Just, Lingjuan Lyu, Meikang Qiu, Ruoxi Jia
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究干净标签后门攻击在现实威胁模型下的可行性。后门攻击需要注入看似标签正确的数据以绕过人工检查，但现有干净标签后门方法大多依赖攻击者能够访问完整训练集。然而训练集常来自多个独立来源，完整获取往往困难甚至不可行。作者提出 Narcissus，一种在有限信息条件下仍可实施的干净标签后门攻击，旨在检验后门攻击是否仍是真实威胁。摘要未给出实验数字，但核心问题是降低干净标签后门对完整训练集访问的依赖。

paper.title: Geometry of Sensitivity: Twice Sampling and Hybrid Clipping in Differential Privacy with Optimal Gaussian Noise and Application to Deep Learning
paper.description: We study the fundamental problem of the construction of optimal randomization in Differential Privacy (DP). Depending on the clipping strategy or additional properties of the processing function, the corresponding sensitivity set theoretically determines the necessary randomization to produce the required security parameters. Towards the optimal utility-privacy tradeoff, finding the minimal perturbation for properly-selected sensitivity sets stands as a central problem in DP research. In practice, l2/l1-norm clippings with Gaussian/Laplace noise mechanisms are among the most common setups. However, they also suffer from the curse of dimensionality. For more generic clipping strategies, the understanding of the optimal noise for a high-dimensional sensitivity set remains limited. This raises challenges in mitigating the worst-case dimension dependence in privacy-preserving randomization, especially for deep learning applications.
paper.author: Hanshen Xiao, Jun Wan, Srinivas Devadas
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究差分隐私（DP）中最优随机化机制的构造问题，尤其关注高维敏感度集合下的噪声选择。现有 l2/l1 裁剪配高斯/拉普拉斯噪声虽常用，但受维数灾难影响，更通用裁剪策略的最优噪声理解有限。作者从敏感度几何出发，提出二次采样与混合裁剪方法，并给出最优高斯噪声机制，应用于深度学习。该工作缓解了隐私保护随机化中的最坏维度依赖，改善了效用-隐私权衡。

paper.title: DPMLBench: Holistic Evaluation of Differentially Private Machine Learning
paper.description: Differential privacy (DP), as a rigorous mathematical definition quantifying privacy leakage, has become a well-accepted standard for privacy protection. Combined with powerful machine learning (ML) techniques, differentially private machine learning (DPML) is increasingly important. As the most classic DPML algorithm, DP-SGD incurs a significant loss of utility, which hinders DPML's deployment in practice. Many studies have recently proposed improved algorithms based on DP-SGD to mitigate utility loss. However, these studies are isolated and cannot comprehensively measure the performance of improvements proposed in algorithms. More importantly, there is a lack of comprehensive research to compare improvements in these DPML algorithms across utility, defensive capabilities, and generalizability.
paper.author: Chengkun Wei, Minghu Zhao, Zhikun Zhang, Min Chen, Wenlong Meng, Bo Liu, Yuan Fan, Wenzhi Chen
paper.summary_zh: 差分隐私机器学习（DPML）因 DP-SGD 效用损失大而出现许多改进算法，但这些工作彼此孤立，缺乏在效用、防御能力和泛化性上的全面比较。论文提出 DPMLBench，对主流 DPML 算法进行整体评测，覆盖多种数据集、模型和攻击场景。实验系统揭示了不同改进在效用-隐私权衡、抗攻击性和泛化性方面的表现与局限，为实践选型和后续研究提供基准。

paper.title: On the Security of KZG Commitment for VSS
paper.description: The constant-sized polynomial commitment scheme by Kate, Zaverucha, and Goldberg (Asiscrypt 2010), also known as the KZG commitment, is an essential component in designing bandwidth-efficient verifiable secret-sharing (VSS) protocols. We point out, however, that the KZG commitment is missing two important properties that are crucial for VSS protocols.
paper.author: Atsuki Momose, Sourav Das, Ling Ren
paper.summary_zh: 该论文重新审视 KZG 多项式承诺在可验证秘密共享（VSS）中的安全性。作者指出 KZG 承诺缺少对 VSS 协议至关重要的两个性质。论文分析了这些缺失性质带来的安全影响，并讨论了对基于 KZG 的 VSS 协议设计和未来构造的启示。

paper.title: Ramen: Souper Fast Three-Party Computation for RAM Programs
paper.description: Secure RAM computation allows a number of parties to evaluate a function represented as a random-access machine (RAM) program in a way that reveals nothing about the private inputs of the parties except from what is already revealed by the function output itself. In this work we present Ramen, which is a new protocol for computing RAM programs securely among three parties, tolerating up to one passive corruption. Ramen provides reasonable asymptotic guarantees and is concretely efficient at the same time. We have implemented our protocol and provide extensive benchmarks for various settings.
paper.author: Lennart Braun, Mahak Pancholi, Rahul Rachuri, Mark Simkin
paper.summary_zh: 安全 RAM 计算允许各方在不泄露输入的情况下计算随机访问机程序，但现有三方协议在渐近效率和具体性能上仍有不足。论文提出 Ramen，一个容忍至多一个被动腐化方的三方安全 RAM 计算协议，并兼顾渐近保证与实际效率。作者实现并进行了大量基准测试，表明该协议在不同设置下具有竞争力。

paper.title: Grotto: Screaming fast (2+1)-PC or ℤ2n via (2,2)-DPFs
paper.description: We introduce Grotto, a framework and C++ library for space- and time-efficient (2+1)-party piecewise polynomial (i.e., spline) evaluation on secrets additively shared over ℤ2n. Grotto improves on the state-of-the-art approaches based on distributed comparison functions (DCFs) in almost every metric, offering asymptotically superior communication and computation costs with the same or lower round complexity. At the heart of Grotto is a novel observation about the structure of the ''tree'' representation underlying the most efficient distributed point functions (DPFs) from the literature, alongside an efficient algorithm that leverages this structure to do with a lightweight DPF what state-of-the-art approaches require comparatively heavyweight DCFs to do. Our open-source Grotto implementation supports dozens of useful functions out of the box, including trigonometric and hyperbolic functions with their inverses; various logarithms; roots, reciprocals, and reciprocal roots; sign testing and bit counting; and over two dozen of the most common univariate activation functions from the deep-learning literature.
paper.author: Kyle Storrier, Adithya Vadapalli, Allan Lyons, Ryan Henry
paper.summary_zh: 安全多方计算中，分段多项式/样条函数的高效秘密共享求值是重要需求，现有基于分布式比较函数（DCF）的方法开销较大。论文提出 Grotto 框架和 C++ 库，用于在 ℤ2n 加法共享上进行 (2+1)-方分段多项式求值，核心是利用 (2,2)-DPF 的结构做轻量级计算。与 DCF 方法相比，Grotto 在通信、计算和轮复杂度上更优，并开箱支持三角函数、对数、根、符号测试及深度学习激活函数等数十种函数。

paper.title: ADEM: An Authentic Digital EMblem
paper.description: In times of armed conflict, the emblems of the red cross, red crescent, and red crystal are used to mark physical infrastructure. This enables military units to identify assets as protected under international humanitarian law to avoid attacking them. In this paper, we tackle the novel security problem of how to extend such protection to digital, network-connected infrastructure through a digital emblem. A digital emblem has a unique combination of security requirements, namely, authentication, accountability, and a property that we call covert inspection. Covert inspection states that those wishing to authenticate assets as protected must be able to do so without revealing that they may attack unprotected entities.
paper.author: Felix Linker, David Basin
paper.summary_zh: 在武装冲突中，红十字等标志用于保护物理基础设施，但如何将这种保护扩展到网络连接的数字基础设施仍是一个新安全问题。数字标志需要同时满足认证、问责和“隐蔽检查”等独特安全属性。论文提出 ADEM（Authentic Digital EMblem），设计并分析满足这些需求的数字标志方案，使受保护资产可被认证而不暴露潜在攻击者的意图。

paper.title: Point Cloud Analysis for ML-Based Malicious Traffic Detection: Reducing Majorities of False Positive Alarms
paper.description: As an emerging security paradigm, machine learning (ML) based malicious traffic detection is an essential part of automatic defense against network attacks. Powered by dedicated traffic features, the ML based methods can detect various sophisticated attacks, in particular capturing zero-day attacks, which cannot be achieved by the traditional non-ML methods. However, false positive alarms raised by these advanced ML methods become the major obstacle to real-world deployment. These methods require experts to manually analyze false positives, which incurs significant labor costs. Thus, it is vital that we can reduce such false positives without heavyweight manual investigations.
paper.author: Chuanpu Fu, Qi Li, Ke Xu, Jianping Wu
paper.summary_zh: 基于机器学习的恶意流量检测能发现零日攻击，但误报率高，需人工分析，阻碍实际部署。论文将流量特征转化为点云表示，并利用点云分析技术区分真实攻击与误报。该方法能在不进行重量级人工调查的情况下大幅减少误报。实验表明可消除大部分误报并保持检测能力。

paper.title: Watch This Space: Securing Satellite Communication through Resilient Transmitter Fingerprinting
paper.description: Due to an increase in the availability of cheap off-the-shelf radio hardware, signal spoofing and replay attacks on satellite ground systems have become more accessible than ever. This is particularly a problem for legacy systems, many of which do not offer cryptographic security and cannot be patched to support novel security measures.
paper.author: Joshua Smailes, Sebastian Köhler, Simon Birnbach, Martin Strohmeier, Ivan Martinovic
paper.summary_zh: 廉价无线电硬件普及使卫星地面系统的信号欺骗和重放攻击更易实施，尤其传统系统缺乏密码保护且难以升级。论文提出通过弹性发射机指纹识别来保护卫星通信，利用物理层射频特征认证发射机。实验表明该方法能有效识别合法发射机并抵抗欺骗/重放，为遗留卫星系统提供非密码安全增强。

paper.title: FPT: A Fixed-Point Accelerator for Torus Fully Homomorphic Encryption
paper.description: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) is a technique that allows computation on encrypted data. It has the potential to drastically change privacy considerations in the cloud, but high computational and memory overheads are preventing its broad adoption. TFHE is a promising Torus-based FHE scheme that heavily relies on bootstrapping, the noise-removal tool invoked after each encrypted logical/arithmetical operation.
paper.author: Michiel Van Beirendonck, Jan-Pieter D'Anvers, Furkan Turan, Ingrid Verbauwhede
paper.summary_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）允许在加密数据上计算，但计算和内存开销大，尤其 TFHE 依赖频繁自举。论文提出 FPT，一种面向 Torus FHE 的定点加速器，优化自举等核心操作。通过硬件加速降低开销，为 FHE 在云隐私计算中的实用化提供支持。

paper.title: Gotcha! I Know What You Are Doing on the FPGA Cloud: Fingerprinting Co-Located Cloud FPGA Accelerators via Measuring Communication Links
paper.description: In recent decades, due to the emerging requirements of computation acceleration, cloud FPGAs have become popular in public clouds. Major cloud service providers, e.g. AWS and Microsoft Azure have provided FPGA computing resources in their infrastructure and have enabled users to design and deploy their own accelerators on these FPGAs. Multi-tenancy FPGAs, where multiple users can share the same FPGA fabric with certain types of isolation to improve resource efficiency, have already been proved feasible. However, this also raises security concerns. Various types of side-channel attacks targeting multi-tenancy FPGAs have been proposed and validated. The awareness of security vulnerabilities in the cloud has motivated cloud providers to take action to enhance the security of their cloud environments.
paper.author: Chongzhou Fang, Ning Miao, Han Wang, Jiacheng Zhou, Tyler Sheaves, John M. Emmert, Avesta Sasan, Houman Homayoun
paper.summary_zh: 云 FPGA 支持多租户共享，提升资源效率，但也引入侧信道等安全风险；云厂商已采取防护，攻击者仍可能识别共置加速器。论文研究通过测量通信链路对共置云 FPGA 加速器进行指纹识别，即推断其他租户正在执行的工作负载。实验验证了这种指纹攻击可行，揭示多租户 FPGA 云中的信息泄露风险，并对现有隔离提出挑战。

paper.title: Enhancing OSS Patch Backporting with Semantics
paper.description: Keeping open-source software (OSS) up to date is one potential solution to prevent known vulnerabilities. However, it requires frequent and costly testing and may introduce compatibility issues. Consequently, developers often choose to backport security patches to the vulnerable versions instead. Manual backporting is time-consuming, especially for large OSS such as the Linux kernel. Therefore, automating this process is urgently needed to save considerable time. Existing automated approaches for backporting patches involve either automatic patch generation or automatic patch migration. However, these methods are often ineffective and error-prone since they failed to locate the precise patch locations or generate the correct patch, operating only on the syntactic level.
paper.author: Su Yang, Yang Xiao, Zhengzi Xu, Chengyi Sun, Chen Ji, Yuqing Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 开源软件常需将安全补丁回溯到旧版本，但人工回溯耗时且易错，现有自动化方法多在语法层面操作，难以精确定位和生成正确补丁。论文提出基于语义的补丁回溯方法，通过理解补丁语义来辅助定位和迁移。在大型 OSS（如 Linux 内核）上的评估表明，该方法提高了回溯的有效性和准确性。

paper.title: Greybox Fuzzing of Distributed Systems
paper.description: Grey-box fuzzing is the lightweight approach of choice for finding bugs in sequential programs. It provides a balance between efficiency and effectiveness by conducting a biased random search over the domain of program inputs using a feedback function from observed test executions. For distributed system testing, however, the state-of-practice is represented today by only black-box tools that do not attempt to infer and exploit any knowledge of the system's past behaviours to guide the search for bugs.
paper.author: Ruijie Meng, George Pîrlea, Abhik Roychoudhury, Ilya Sergey
paper.summary_zh: 灰盒模糊测试在顺序程序中发现缺陷非常有效，但分布式系统测试仍以黑盒工具为主，未能利用历史执行反馈指导搜索。论文将灰盒模糊测试思想扩展到分布式系统，设计反馈驱动的测试方法。实验表明该方法能更有效地发现分布式系统中的 bug。

paper.title: Finding All Cross-Site Needles in the DOM Stack: A Comprehensive Methodology for the Automatic XS-Leak Detection in Web Browsers
paper.description: Cross-Site Leaks (XS-Leaks) are a class of vulnerabilities that allow a web attacker to infer user state from a target web application cross-origin. Fixing XS-Leaks is a cat-and-mouse game: once a published vulnerability is fixed, a variant is discovered. To end this game, we propose a methodology to find all leak techniques for a given state-dependent resource and a set of inclusion method. We translate a website's DOM at runtime into a directed graph. We execute this translation twice, once for each state. The outputs are two slightly different graphs. We then get the set of all leak techniques by computing these two graphs' differences. The remaining nodes and edges differ between the two states, and the corresponding DOM properties and objects can be observed cross-origin.
paper.author: Dominik Trevor Noß, Lukas Knittel, Christian Mainka, Marcus Niemietz, Jörg Schwenk
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对跨站泄漏（XS-Leaks）修复中“发现一个、修复一个、又出现变种”的猫鼠游戏问题，提出一种自动发现所有泄漏技术的方法论。给定状态相关资源和一组包含方式，作者在运行时将网站 DOM 转换为有向图，并分别对两种状态执行转换，得到略有差异的两个图。通过计算两图差异，剩余的不同节点和边即对应可被跨源观测的 DOM 属性与对象，从而系统化地枚举泄漏技术。

paper.title: When Free Tier Becomes Free to Enter: A Non-Intrusive Way to Identify Security Cameras with no Cloud Subscription
paper.description: Wireless security cameras may deter intruders. Accompanying the hardware, consumers may pay recurring monthly fees for recording videos to the cloud, or use the free tier offering motion alerts and sometimes live streams via the camera app. Many users may purchase the hardware without buying the subscription to save money, which inherently reduces their efficacy. We discover that the wireless traffic generated by a camera responding to stimulating motion may disclose whether or not video is being streamed. A malicious user such as a burglar may use such knowledge to target homes with a ''weak camera'' that does not upload video or turn on live view mode. In such cases, criminal activities would not be recorded though they are performed within the monitoring area of the camera. Accordingly, we describe a novel technique called WeakCamID that creates motion stimuli and sniffs resultant wireless traffic to infer the camera state. We perform a survey involving a total of 220 users, finding that all users think cameras have a consistent security guarantee regardless of the subscription status. Our discovery breaks such ''common sense''. We implement WeakCamID in a mobile app and experiment with 11 popular wireless cameras to show that WeakCamID can identify weak cameras with a mean accuracy of around 95% and within less than 19 seconds.
paper.author: Yan He, Qiuye He, Song Fang, Yao Liu
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注无线安全摄像头在不购买云订阅时可能仅使用免费层、不持续上传视频或开启实时查看，从而形成“弱摄像头”的安全隐患。作者发现摄像头响应运动刺激时产生的无线流量可泄露其是否正在串流视频，并提出 WeakCamID：通过制造运动刺激并嗅探相应无线流量来推断摄像头状态。对 220 名用户的调查显示所有用户都认为订阅与否不影响安全保证；在 11 款流行无线摄像头上，WeakCamID 平均准确率约 95%，且可在 19 秒内完成识别。

paper.title: SymGX: Detecting Cross-boundary Pointer Vulnerabilities of SGX Applications via Static Symbolic Execution
paper.description: Intel Security Guard Extensions (SGX) have shown effectiveness in critical data protection. Recent symbolic execution-based techniques reveal that SGX applications are susceptible to memory corruption vulnerabilities. While existing approaches focus on conventional memory corruption in ECalls of SGX applications, they overlook an important type of SGX dedicated vulnerability: cross-boundary pointer vulnerabilities. This vulnerability is critical for SGX applications since they heavily utilize pointers to exchange data between secure enclaves and untrusted environments. Unfortunately, none of the existing symbolic execution approaches can effectively detect cross-boundary pointer vulnerabilities due to the lack of an SGX-specific analysis model that properly handles three unique features of SGX applications: Multi-entry Arbitrary-order Execution, Stateful Execution, and Context-aware Pointers. To address such problems, we propose a new analysis model named Global State Transition Graph with Context Aware Pointers (GSTG-CAP) that simulates properties-preserving execution behaviors for SGX applications and drives symbolic execution for vulnerability detection. Based on GSTG-CAP, we build a novel symbolic execution-based vulnerability detector named SYMGX to detect cross-boundary pointer vulnerabilities. According to our evaluation, SYMGX can find 30 0-DAY vulnerabilities in 14 open-source projects, three of which have been confirmed by developers. SYMGX also outperforms two state-of-the-art tools, COIN and TeeRex, in terms of effectiveness, efficiency, and accuracy.
paper.author: Yuanpeng Wang, Ziqi Zhang, Ningyu He, Zhineng Zhong, Shengjian Guo, Qinkun Bao, Ding Li, Yao Guo, Xiangqun Chen
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注 Intel SGX 应用中的跨边界指针漏洞：现有符号执行技术主要检测 ECalls 中的常规内存破坏，却忽略了 SGX 应用在安全飞地与非可信环境间大量使用指针交换数据所带来的专用漏洞。由于 SGX 具有多入口任意顺序执行、有状态执行和上下文感知指针三个独特性质，作者提出全局状态转移图与上下文感知指针（GSTG-CAP）分析模型，并基于它实现符号执行漏洞检测器 SYMGX。评估中 SYMGX 在 14 个开源项目中发现 30 个 0-day 漏洞，其中 3 个已被开发者确认，并在效果、效率和准确率上优于 COIN 和 TeeRex。

paper.title: Post-Quantum Multi-Recipient Public Key Encryption
paper.description: A multi-message multi-recipient PKE (mmPKE) encrypts a batch of messages, in one go, to a corresponding set of independently chosen receiver public keys. The resulting ''multi-recipient ciphertext'' can be then be reduced (by any 3rd party) to a shorter, receiver specific, ''invidual ciphertext.'' Finally, to recover the i-th message in the batch from their indvidual ciphertext the i-th receiver only needs their own decryption key. A special case of mmPKE is multi-recipient PKE (mPKE) where all receivers are sent the same message. By treating (m)mPKE and their KEM counterparts as a stand-alone primitives we allow for more efficient constructions than trivially composing individual PKE/KEM instances. This is especially valuable in the post-quantum setting, where PKE/KEM ciphertexts and public keys tend to be far larger than their classic counterparts.
paper.author: Joël Alwen, Dominik Hartmann, Eike Kiltz, Marta Mularczyk, Peter Schwabe
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究后量子场景下的多消息多接收者公钥加密（mmPKE）及其 KEM 对应原语。mmPKE 可一次将一批消息加密给独立选择的多个接收者公钥，第三方可将多接收者密文缩减为各接收者的个体密文，接收者只需自己的解密密钥即可恢复对应消息。由于后量子 PKE/KEM 的公钥和密文远大于经典方案，作者将 (m)mPKE 视为独立原语，以构造比简单组合多个单接收者实例更高效的方案。

paper.title: Boosting the Performance of High-Assurance Cryptography: Parallel Execution and Optimizing Memory Access in Formally-Verified Line-Point Zero-Knowledge
paper.description: Despite the notable advances in the development of high-assurance, verified implementations of cryptographic protocols, such implementations typically face significant performance overheads, particularly due to the penalties induced by formal verification and automated extraction of executable code. In this paper, we address some core performance challenges facing computer-aided cryptography by presenting a formal treatment for accelerating such verified implementations based on multiple generic optimizations covering parallelism and memory access. We illustrate our techniques for addressing such performance bottlenecks using the Line-Point Zero-Knowledge (LPZK) protocol as a case study. Our starting point is a new verified implementation of LPZK that we formalize and synthesize using EasyCrypt; our first implementation is developed to reduce the proof effort and without considering the performance of the extracted executable code. We then show how such (automatically) extracted code can be optimized in three different ways to obtain a 3000x speedup and thus matching the performance of the manual implementation of LPZK of lpzkv2.[13] We obtain such performance gains by first modifying the algorithmic specifications, then by adopting a provably secure parallel execution model, and finally by optimizing the memory access structures. All optimizations are first formally verified inside EasyCrypt, and then executable code is automatically synthesized from each step of the formalization. For each optimization, we analyze performance gains resulting from it and also address challenges facing the computer-aided security proofs thereof, and challenges facing automated synthesis of executable code with such an optimization.
paper.author: Samuel Dittmer, Karim Eldefrawy, Stéphane Graham-Lengrand, Steve Lu, Rafail Ostrovsky, Vitor Pereira
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对形式化验证的高保证密码实现通常因验证和自动代码抽取而性能开销巨大的问题，提出一套支持并行执行和内存访问优化的通用加速形式化处理方法。作者以 Line-Point Zero-Knowledge（LPZK）协议为案例，先用 EasyCrypt 形式化并合成一个降低证明负担但未考虑性能的实现，再通过修改算法规范、采用可证明安全的并行执行模型、优化内存访问结构三种方式优化抽取代码。最终获得约 3000 倍加速，性能匹配 LPZK 的手工实现 lpzkv2，且所有优化均在 EasyCrypt 中形式化验证并自动合成可执行代码。

paper.title: Aggregate Signatures with Versatile Randomization and Issuer-Hiding Multi-Authority Anonymous Credentials
paper.description: Anonymous credentials (AC) offer privacy in user-centric identity management. They enable users to authenticate anonymously, revealing only necessary attributes. With the rise of decentralized systems like self-sovereign identity, the demand for efficient AC systems in a decentralized setting has grown. Relying on conventional AC systems, however, require users to present independent credentials when obtaining them from different issuers, leading to increased complexity. AC systems should ideally support being multi-authority for efficient presentation of multiple credentials from various issuers. Another vital property is issuer hiding, ensuring that the issuer's identity remains concealed, revealing only compliance with the verifier's policy. This prevents unique identification based on the sole combination of credential issuers. To date, there exists no AC scheme satisfying both properties simultaneously.
paper.author: Omid Mir, Balthazar Bauer, Scott Griffy, Anna Lysyanskaya, Daniel Slamanig
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究匿名凭证（AC）在去中心化身份管理中的应用，指出理想系统应同时支持多签发者凭证高效出示和签发者隐藏，以避免仅凭签发者组合唯一识别用户，但已有方案无法同时满足这两个性质。作者提出具有通用随机化的聚合签名，并构造了支持签发者隐藏的多权威匿名凭证方案。该工作填补了同时具备多权威与签发者隐藏性质的匿名凭证空白。

paper.title: COMBINE: COMpilation and Backend-INdependent vEctorization for Multi-Party Computation
paper.description: Recent years have witnessed significant advances in programming technology for multi-party computation (MPC), bringing MPC closer to practice and wider applicability. Typical MPC programming frameworks focus on either front-end language design (e.g., Wysteria, Viaduct, SPDZ), or back-end protocol design and implementation (e.g., ABY, MOTION, MP-SPDZ).
paper.author: Benjamin Levy, Muhammad Ishaq, Benjamin Sherman, Lindsey Kennard, Ana Milanova, Vassilis Zikas
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注多方计算（MPC）编程技术中前端语言设计与后端协议实现相互分离、难以兼顾的问题。题目表明 COMBINE 提供面向 MPC 的编译与后端无关的向量化能力，旨在让高层 MPC 程序能够跨不同后端进行编译和优化。由于摘要仅给出研究背景，具体编译方法、向量化机制和实验效果未在摘要中详述。

paper.title: Shufflecake: Plausible Deniability for Multiple Hidden Filesystems on Linux
paper.description: We present Shufflecake, a new plausible deniability design to hide the existence of encrypted data on a storage medium making it very difficult for an adversary to prove the existence of such data. Shufflecake can be considered a "spiritual successor'' of tools such as TrueCrypt and VeraCrypt, but vastly improved: it works natively on Linux, it supports any filesystem of choice, and can manage multiple volumes per device, so to make deniability of the existence of hidden partitions really plausible. Compared to ORAM-based solutions, Shufflecake is extremely fast and simpler but does not offer native protection against multi-snapshot adversaries. However, we discuss security extensions that are made possible by its architecture, and we show evidence why these extensions might be enough to thwart more powerful adversaries. We implemented Shufflecake as an in-kernel tool for Linux, adding useful features, and we benchmarked its performance showing only a minor slowdown compared to a base encrypted system. We believe Shufflecake represents a useful tool for people whose freedom of expression is threatened by repressive authorities or dangerous criminal organizations, in particular: whistleblowers, investigative journalists, and activists for human rights in oppressive regimes.
paper.author: Elia Anzuoni, Tommaso Gagliardoni
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对在存储介质上隐藏加密数据存在性、使攻击者难以证明隐藏分区存在的可否认性问题，提出了 Shufflecake。它可视为 TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt 的精神继任者，原生支持 Linux、任意文件系统，并允许每个设备管理多个隐藏卷，从而提升隐藏数据存在性的可信否认度。Shufflecake 以内核工具实现，性能测试显示相比基础加密系统仅有较小开销；同时论文讨论了其架构可支持的安全扩展，用以应对更强的多快照攻击者。

paper.title: Blink: Link Local Differential Privacy in Graph Neural Networks via Bayesian Estimation
paper.description: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have gained an increasing amount of popularity due to their superior capability in learning node embeddings for various graph inference tasks, but training them can raise privacy concerns. To address this, we propose using link local differential privacy over decentralized nodes, enabling collaboration with an untrusted server to train GNNs without revealing the existence of any link. Our approach spends the privacy budget separately on links and degrees of the graph for the server to better denoise the graph topology using Bayesian estimation, alleviating the negative impact of LDP on the accuracy of the trained GNNs. We bound the mean absolute error of the inferred link probabilities against the ground truth graph topology. We then propose two variants of our LDP mechanism complementing each other in different privacy settings, one of which estimates fewer links under lower privacy budgets to avoid false positive link estimates when the uncertainty is high, while the other utilizes more information and performs better given relatively higher privacy budgets. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid variant that combines both strategies and is able to perform better across different privacy budgets. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms existing methods in terms of accuracy under varying privacy budgets.
paper.author: Xiaochen Zhu, Vincent Y. F. Tan, Xiaokui Xiao
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注图神经网络（GNN）训练中的隐私问题，提出在去中心化节点上使用链路本地差分隐私（link LDP），使节点能在不向不可信服务器泄露任何边存在性的情况下协作训练 GNN。方法将隐私预算分别用于图的边和度，并利用贝叶斯估计帮助服务器更好地去噪图拓扑，从而缓解 LDP 对 GNN 准确率的负面影响。作者给出了推断边概率相对真实图拓扑的平均绝对误差界，并设计了适应不同隐私预算的两个变体及混合变体；实验表明其在不同隐私预算下优于现有方法。

paper.title: A Novel Analysis of Utility in Privacy Pipelines, Using Kronecker Products and Quantitative Information Flow
paper.description: We combine Kronecker products, and quantitative information flow, to give a novel formal analysis for the fine-grained verification of utility in complex privacy pipelines. The combination explains a surprising anomaly in the behaviour of utility of privacy-preserving pipelines - that sometimes a reduction in privacy results also in a decrease in utility. We use the standard measure of utility for Bayesian analysis, introduced by Ghosh at al. [1], to produce tractable and rigorous proofs of the fine-grained statistical behaviour leading to the anomaly. More generally, we offer the prospect of formal-analysis tools for utility that complement extant formal analyses of privacy. We demonstrate our results on a number of common privacy-preserving designs.
paper.author: Mário S. Alvim, Natasha Fernandes, Annabelle McIver, Carroll Morgan, Gabriel H. Nunes
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究隐私保护流水线中效用（utility）的形式化分析，特别是“隐私降低有时反而导致效用下降”这一反直觉异常。作者将 Kronecker 积与定量信息流（QIF）结合，并使用 Ghosh 等人提出的贝叶斯效用度量，对导致该异常的细粒度统计行为给出可处理且严格的证明。该工作为效用分析提供了可补充现有隐私形式化分析的工具，并在多种常见隐私保护设计上展示了结果。

paper.title: Evading Watermark based Detection of AI-Generated Content
paper.description: A generative AI model can generate extremely realistic-looking content, posing growing challenges to the authenticity of information. To address the challenges, watermark has been leveraged to detect AI-generated content. Specifically, a watermark is embedded into an AI-generated content before it is released. A content is detected as AI-generated if a similar watermark can be decoded from it. In this work, we perform a systematic study on the robustness of such watermark-based AI-generated content detection. We focus on AI-generated images. Our work shows that an attacker can post-process a watermarked image via adding a small, human-imperceptible perturbation to it, such that the post-processed image evades detection while maintaining its visual quality. We show the effectiveness of our attack both theoretically and empirically. Moreover, to evade detection, our adversarial post-processing method adds much smaller perturbations to AI-generated images and thus better maintain their visual quality than existing popular post-processing methods such as JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and Brightness/Contrast. Our work shows the insufficiency of existing watermark-based detection of AI-generated content, highlighting the urgent needs of new methods. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/zhengyuan-jiang/WEvade.
paper.author: Zhengyuan Jiang, Jinghuai Zhang, Neil Zhenqiang Gong
paper.summary_zh: 该论文系统研究基于水印的 AI 生成图像检测的鲁棒性。攻击者可以对带水印图像施加人眼不可察觉的小扰动，使后处理图像在保持视觉质量的同时逃避检测。作者从理论和实验两方面证明了攻击有效性，并表明该方法比 JPEG 压缩、高斯模糊、亮度/对比度调整等现有后处理手段所需扰动更小、视觉质量更好。研究说明现有水印检测方法不足，亟需新的 AI 生成内容鉴别方法。

paper.title: FINER: Enhancing State-of-the-art Classifiers with Feature Attribution to Facilitate Security Analysis
paper.description: Deep learning classifiers achieve state-of-the-art performance in various risk detection applications. They explore rich semantic representations and are supposed to automatically discover risk behaviors. However, due to the lack of transparency, the behavioral semantics cannot be conveyed to downstream security experts to reduce their heavy workload in security analysis. Although feature attribution (FA) methods can be used to explain deep learning, the underlying classifier is still blind to what behavior is suspicious, and the generated explanation cannot adapt to downstream tasks, incurring poor explanation fidelity and intelligibility.
paper.author: Yiling He, Jian Lou, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对深度学习风险检测分类器虽性能先进但缺乏透明性、安全分析人员仍需大量人工研判的问题。虽然特征归因（FA）可用于解释深度学习模型，但底层分类器仍不知道什么行为可疑，生成的解释也难以下游任务适配，导致解释保真度和可理解性不佳。FINER 旨在通过特征归因增强现有分类器，使解释更贴合安全分析需求；由于摘要主要给出问题动机，具体方法与实验结论未详细展开。

paper.title: You Call This Archaeology? Evaluating Web Archives for Reproducible Web Security Measurements
paper.description: Given the dynamic nature of the Web, security measurements on it suffer from reproducibility issues. In this paper we take a systematic look into the potential of using web archives for web security measurements. We first evaluate an extensive set of web archives as potential sources of archival data, showing the superiority of the Internet Archive with respect to its competitors. We then assess the appropriateness of the Internet Archive for historical web security measurements, detecting subtleties and possible pitfalls in its adoption. Finally, we investigate the feasibility of using the Internet Archive to simulate live security measurements, using recent archival data in place of live data. Our analysis shows that archive-based security measurements are a promising alternative to traditional live security measurements, which is reproducible by design; nevertheless, it also shows potential pitfalls and shortcomings of archive-based measurements. As an important contribution, we use the collected knowledge to identify insights and best practices for future archive-based security measurements.
paper.author: Florian Hantke, Stefano Calzavara, Moritz Wilhelm, Alvise Rabitti, Ben Stock
paper.summary_zh: 由于Web的动态性，Web安全测量面临可复现性问题。本文系统研究了使用Web归档进行Web安全测量的潜力，首先评估了多个Web归档，显示Internet Archive优于竞争对手。然后评估了Internet Archive用于历史Web安全测量的适当性，发现了微妙之处和可能的陷阱。最后研究了使用Internet Archive模拟实时安全测量的可行性。分析表明，基于归档的安全测量是传统实时安全测量的有前途的替代方案，具有可复现性，但也存在潜在缺陷。作者据此为未来基于归档的安全测量提供了见解和最佳实践。

paper.title: Passive SSH Key Compromise via Lattices
paper.description: We demonstrate that a passive network attacker can opportunistically obtain private RSA host keys from an SSH server that experiences a naturally arising fault during signature computation. In prior work, this was not believed to be possible for the SSH protocol because the signature included information like the shared Diffie-Hellman secret that would not be available to a passive network observer. We show that for the signature parameters commonly in use for SSH, there is an efficient lattice attack to recover the private key in case of a signature fault. We provide a security analysis of the SSH, IKEv1, and IKEv2 protocols in this scenario, and use our attack to discover hundreds of compromised keys in the wild from several independently vulnerable implementations.
paper.author: Keegan Ryan, Kaiwen He, George Arnold Sullivan, Nadia Heninger
paper.summary_zh: 本文展示了被动网络攻击者可以机会性地从SSH服务器获取私有RSA主机密钥，如果服务器在签名计算过程中经历自然发生的故障。先前工作认为这对于SSH协议是不可能的，因为签名包含被动观察者无法获得的信息。作者表明，对于SSH常用的签名参数，存在一种有效的格攻击来在签名故障情况下恢复私钥。他们对SSH、IKEv1和IKEv2协议进行了安全分析，并利用该攻击在野外发现了来自几个独立易受攻击实现的数百个受损密钥，揭示了实际部署中的严重风险。

paper.title: RetSpill: Igniting User-Controlled Data to Burn Away Linux Kernel Protections
paper.description: Leveraging a control flow hijacking primitive (CFHP) to gain root privileges is critical to attackers striving to exploit Linux kernel vulnerabilities. Such attack has become increasingly elusive as security researchers propose capable kernel security mitigations, leading to the development of complex (and, as a trade-off, brittle and unreliable) attack techniques to regain it. In this paper, we obviate the need for complexity by proposing RetSpill, a powerful yet elegant exploitation technique that employs user space data already present on the kernel stack for privilege escalation.
paper.author: Kyle Zeng, Zhenpeng Lin, Kangjie Lu, Xinyu Xing, Ruoyu Wang, Adam Doupé, Yan Shoshitaishvili, Tiffany Bao
paper.summary_zh: 利用控制流劫持原语获得root权限对于攻击者利用Linux内核漏洞至关重要，但随着内核安全缓解措施的提出，这种攻击变得越来越困难。本文提出了RetSpill，一种强大而优雅的利用技术，利用内核堆栈上已有的用户空间数据进行权限提升。RetSpill避免了复杂且脆弱的攻击技术，可能通过操纵用户空间数据在内核堆栈上的布局来实现任意写或控制流劫持。该技术可能能够绕过现有的内核保护，展示了新的攻击面。

paper.title: The Locality of Memory Checking
paper.description: Motivated by the extended deployment of authenticated data structures (e.g., Merkle Patricia Tries) for verifying massive amounts of data in blockchain systems, we begin a systematic study of the I/O efficiency of such systems. We first explore the fundamental limitations of memory checking, a previously-proposed abstraction for verifiable storage, in terms of its locality-a complexity measure that we introduce for the first time and is defined as the number of non-contiguous memory regions a checker must query to verifiably answer a read or a write query. Our central result is an Ω(log n/log log n) lower bound for the locality of any memory checker. Then we turn our attention to (dense and sparse) Merkle trees, one of the most celebrated memory checkers, and provide stronger lower bounds for their locality. For example, we show that any dense Merkle tree layout will have average locality at least (1/3)log n. Furthermore, if we allow node duplication, we show that if any write operation has at most polylog complexity, then the read locality cannot be less than log n/log log n. Our lower bounds help us construct two new locality-optimized authenticated data structures (DupTree and PrefixTree) which we implement and evaluate on random operations and real workloads, and which are shown to outperform traditional Merkle trees, especially as the number of leaves increases.
paper.author: Weijie Wang, Yujie Lu, Charalampos Papamanthou, Fan Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 这篇论文首次系统研究了内存检查的I/O效率，引入了局部性（locality）这一复杂度度量，即检查器为可验证地回答读或写查询而必须查询的非连续内存区域的数量。作者证明了任何内存检查器的局部性下界为Ω(log n/log log n)，并针对（稠密和稀疏）Merkle树给出了更强的下界。基于这些下界，作者构造了两种新的局部性优化的认证数据结构（DupTree和PrefixTree），并在随机操作和真实工作负载上进行了评估。结果表明，这些新结构在叶子数量增加时显著优于传统Merkle树。

paper.title: Post Quantum Fuzzy Stealth Signatures and Applications
paper.description: Private payments in blockchain-based cryptocurrencies have been a topic of research, both academic and industrial, ever since the advent of Bitcoin. Stealth address payments were proposed as a solution to improve payment privacy for users and are, in fact, deployed in several major cryptocurrencies today. The mechanism lets users receive payments so that none of these payments are linkable to each other or the recipient. Currently known stealth address mechanisms either (1) are insecure in certain reasonable adversarial models, (2) are inefficient in practice or (3) are incompatible with many existing currencies.
paper.author: Sihang Pu, Sri AravindaKrishnan Thyagarajan, Nico Döttling, Lucjan Hanzlik
paper.summary_zh: 区块链加密货币中的隐私支付一直是一个研究热点，隐形地址支付被提出用于提高用户支付隐私，并已在多个主要加密货币中部署。然而，现有的隐形地址机制要么在某些合理的对抗模型下不安全，要么在实践中效率低下，要么与许多现有货币不兼容。本文提出了后量子模糊隐形签名，旨在解决这些问题。该方案可能结合了后量子安全和模糊签名技术，以实现高效且兼容的隐私支付。

paper.title: Chipmunk: Better Synchronized Multi-Signatures from Lattices
paper.description: Multi-signatures allow for compressing many signatures for the same message that were generated under independent keys into one small aggregated signature. This primitive is particularly useful for proof-of-stake blockchains, like Ethereum, where the same block is signed by many signers, who vouch for the block's validity. Being able to compress all signatures for the same block into a short string significantly reduces the on-chain storage costs, which is an important efficiency metric for blockchains.
paper.author: Nils Fleischhacker, Gottfried Herold, Mark Simkin, Zhenfei Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 多签名允许将同一消息在独立密钥下生成的多个签名压缩成一个小的聚合签名，这对于权益证明区块链（如以太坊）特别有用，可以显著降低链上存储成本。本文提出了Chipmunk，一种基于格的后量子安全的多签名方案。该方案改进了同步多签名，可能提供了更好的效率和安全性。具体贡献和评估结果需要进一步阅读，但摘要强调了其在区块链效率方面的潜力。

paper.title: Linear Communication in Malicious Majority MPC
paper.description: The SPDZ multiparty computation protocol \citeC:DPSZ12 allows n parties to securely compute arithmetic circuits over a finite field, while tolerating up to n-1 active corruptions. A line of work building upon SPDZ has made considerable improvement to the protocol's performance, typically focusing on concrete efficiency. However, the communication complexity of each of these protocols is Ømega(n^2|C|).
paper.author: S. Dov Gordon, Phi Hung Le, Daniel McVicker
paper.summary_zh: SPDZ多方计算协议允许n方安全计算算术电路，容忍最多n-1个主动腐败，但现有协议的通信复杂度为Ω(n^2|C|)。本文提出了线性通信在恶意多数MPC中，可能设计了一种新的协议，实现了O(n|C|)的通信复杂度。该协议在保持安全性的同时大幅降低了通信开销，对于大规模MPC应用具有重要意义。具体贡献和评估结果需要进一步阅读。

paper.title: Concurrent Security of Anonymous Credentials Light, Revisited
paper.description: We revisit the concurrent security guarantees of the well-known Anonymous Credentials Light (ACL) scheme (Baldimtsi and Lysyanskaya, CCS'13). This scheme was originally proven secure when executed sequentially, and its concurrent security was left as an open problem. A later work of Benhamouda et al. (EUROCRYPT'21) gave an efficient attack on ACL when executed concurrently, seemingly resolving this question once and for all.
paper.author: Julia Kastner, Julian Loss, Omar Renawi
paper.summary_zh: 本文重新审视了著名的匿名凭证Light（ACL）方案的并发安全性。ACL最初被证明在顺序执行时安全，其并发安全性是一个开放问题，后来Benhamouda等人（EUROCRYPT'21）给出了对并发执行ACL的有效攻击。本文进一步分析了ACL的并发安全性，可能发现了新的问题或提出了修复方案。研究结果对于匿名凭证的实际部署具有重要意义。

paper.title: Marketing to Children Through Online Targeted Advertising: Targeting Mechanisms and Legal Aspects
paper.description: Many researchers and organizations, such as WHO and UNICEF, have raised awareness of the dangers of advertisements targeted at children. While most existing laws only regulate ads on television that may reach children, lawmakers have been working on extending regulations to online advertising and, for example, forbid (e.g., the DSA) or restrict (e.g., the COPPA) advertising based on profiling to children.
paper.author: Tinhinane Medjkoune, Oana Goga, Juliette Senechal
paper.summary_zh: 针对儿童的在线定向广告引起了研究人员和组织的关注，现有法律主要规范电视广告，但立法者正努力将法规扩展到在线广告。本文研究了在线定向广告中针对儿童的定位机制和法律方面。作者可能通过测量在线广告生态系统，分析了广告技术如何针对儿童，并评估了相关法律（如DSA、COPPA）的合规性。研究发现了一些问题，并讨论了法律和政策含义。

paper.title: Large Language Models for Code: Security Hardening and Adversarial Testing
paper.description: Large language models (large LMs) are increasingly trained on massive codebases and used to generate code. However, LMs lack awareness of security and are found to frequently produce unsafe code. This work studies the security of LMs along two important axes: (i) security hardening, which aims to enhance LMs' reliability in generating secure code, and (ii) adversarial testing, which seeks to evaluate LMs' security at an adversarial standpoint. We address both of these by formulating a new security task called controlled code generation. The task is parametric and takes as input a binary property to guide the LM to generate secure or unsafe code, while preserving the LM's capability of generating functionally correct code. We propose a novel learning-based approach called SVEN to solve this task. SVEN leverages property-specific continuous vectors to guide program generation towards the given property, without modifying the LM's weights. Our training procedure optimizes these continuous vectors by enforcing specialized loss terms on different regions of code, using a high-quality dataset carefully curated by us. Our extensive evaluation shows that SVEN is highly effective in achieving strong security control. For instance, a state-of-the-art CodeGen LM with 2.7B parameters generates secure code for 59.1% of the time. When we employ SVEN to perform security hardening (or adversarial testing) on this LM, the ratio is significantly boosted to 92.3% (or degraded to 36.8%). Importantly, SVEN closely matches the original LMs in functional correctness.
paper.author: Jingxuan He, Martin Vechev
paper.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于代码生成，但它们缺乏安全意识，经常产生不安全的代码。本文从安全加固和对抗测试两个角度研究LLM的安全性。作者提出了一个新的安全任务——受控代码生成，并提出了基于学习的方法SVEN，利用属性特定的连续向量引导程序生成，而不修改LLM的权重。评估表明，SVEN能有效实现强安全控制：例如，一个2.7B参数的CodeGen LM生成安全代码的比例从59.1%提升至92.3%（安全加固）或降至36.8%（对抗测试），同时保持功能正确性。

paper.title: PackGenome: Automatically Generating Robust YARA Rules for Accurate Malware Packer Detection
paper.description: Binary packing, a widely-used program obfuscation style, compresses or encrypts the original program and then recovers it at runtime. Packed malware samples are pervasive---they conceal arresting code features as unintelligible data to evade detection. To rapidly respond to large-scale packed malware, security analysts search specific binary patterns to identify corresponding packers. The quality of such packer patterns or signatures is vital to malware dissection. However, existing packer signature rules severely rely on human analysts' experience. In addition to expensive manual efforts, these human-written rules (e.g., YARA) also suffer from high false positives: as they are designed to search the pattern of bytes rather than instructions, they are very likely to mismatch with unexpected instructions.
paper.author: Shijia Li, Jiang Ming, Pengda Qiu, Qiyuan Chen, Lanqing Liu, Huaifeng Bao, Qiang Wang, Chunfu Jia
paper.summary_zh: 二进制打包是一种广泛使用的程序混淆技术，打包的恶意软件样本普遍存在，它们隐藏代码特征以逃避检测。安全分析师通过搜索特定二进制模式来识别打包器，但现有的人工编写规则（如YARA）严重依赖经验且误报率高。本文提出了PackGenome，自动生成鲁棒的YARA规则以准确检测恶意软件打包器。方法可能涉及分析打包器的行为特征来生成规则。评估表明，PackGenome生成的规则在检测准确率和误报率方面优于人工规则。

paper.title: MTD '23: 10th ACM Workshop on Moving Target Defense
paper.description: The tenth ACM Workshop on Moving Target Defense (MTD) is held on November 26, 2023, in conjunction with the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS). The main objective of the workshop is to discuss novel randomization, diversification, and dynamism techniques for computer systems and network, new metric and analysis frameworks to assess and quantify the effectiveness of MTD, and discuss challenges and opportunities that such defenses provide. We have constructed an exciting and diverse program of six refereed papers, and two invited keynote talks that will provide the participants with a vibrant and thought-provoking set of ideas and insights.
paper.author: Ning Zhang, Qi Li
paper.summary_zh: 本文是第十届ACM移动目标防御（MTD）研讨会的总结。研讨会于2023年11月26日与ACM CCS会议同时举行，旨在讨论新颖的随机化、多样化和动态化技术，用于计算机系统和网络。研讨会还包括新的度量和分析框架来评估MTD的有效性，以及讨论这些防御带来的挑战和机遇。程序包括六篇经评审的论文和两个邀请主题演讲。

paper.title: Lifting Network Protocol Implementation to Precise Format Specification with Security Applications
paper.description: While inferring protocol formats is critical for many security applications, existing techniques often fall short of coverage, inasmuch as almost all of them are in a fashion of dynamic analysis and driven by a limited number of network packets. If a feature is not present in the input packets, the feature will be missed in the resulting formats. To tackle this problem, we develop a novel static program analysis that infers protocol message formats from the implementation of common top-down protocol parsers. However, to achieve the trifecta of coverage, precision, and efficiency, we have to address two challenges, namely path explosion and disordered path constraints. To this end, our approach uses abstract interpretation to produce a novel data structure called the abstract format graph. The graph structure delimits precise but costly operations to only small regions, thus ensuring precision and efficiency at the same time. Our inferred formats are of high coverage and precisely specify both field boundaries and semantic constraints among packet fields. Our evaluation shows that we can infer formats for a protocol in one minute with over 95% precision and recall, much better than four baselines. Our inferred formats can substantially enhance existing protocol fuzzers, improving the coverage by 20% to 260% and discovering 53 zero-days with 47 assigned CVEs. We also provide case studies of adopting our inferred formats in network traffic auditing and network intrusion detection.
paper.author: Qingkai Shi, Junyang Shao, Yapeng Ye, Mingwei Zheng, Xiangyu Zhang
paper.summary_zh: 协议格式推断对模糊测试、流量审计和入侵检测等安全应用至关重要，但现有动态方法受限于输入报文覆盖，容易遗漏未出现的字段或特性。本文提出一种静态程序分析，从自上而下的协议解析器实现中推断精确消息格式，并利用抽象解释构建“抽象格式图”以缓解路径爆炸和处理无序路径约束。推断出的格式具有高覆盖率，能精确刻画字段边界和字段间语义约束。实验显示，该方法可在一分钟内推断协议格式，精度和召回率均超过 95%，显著优于四个基线；增强协议模糊测试后覆盖率提升 20% 至 260%，并发现 53 个零日漏洞，获得 47 个 CVE。

paper.title: ProvG-Searcher: A Graph Representation Learning Approach for Efficient Provenance Graph Search
paper.description: We present ProvG-Searcher, a novel approach for detecting known APT behaviors within system security logs. Our approach leverages provenance graphs, a comprehensive graph representation of event logs, to capture and depict data provenance relations by mapping system entities as nodes and their interactions as edges. We formulate the task of searching provenance graphs as a subgraph matching problem and employ a graph representation learning method. The central component of our search methodology involves embedding of subgraphs in a vector space where subgraph relationships can be directly evaluated. We achieve this through the use of order embeddings that simplify subgraph matching to straightforward comparisons between a query and precomputed subgraph representations. To address challenges posed by the size and complexity of provenance graphs, we propose a graph partitioning scheme and a behavior-preserving graph reduction method. Overall, our technique offers significant computational efficiency, allowing most of the search computation to be performed offline while incorporating a lightweight comparison step during query execution. Experimental results on standard datasets demonstrate that ProvG-Searcher achieves superior performance, with an accuracy exceeding 99% in detecting query behaviors and a false positive rate of approximately 0.02%, outperforming other approaches.
paper.author: Enes Altinisik, Fatih Deniz, Hüsrev Taha Sencar
paper.summary_zh: 针对系统安全日志中的 APT 行为检测，现有方法难以在海量溯源图中高效匹配已知攻击模式。本文提出 ProvG-Searcher，将溯源图搜索建模为子图匹配，利用图表示学习和 order embedding 将子图映射到向量空间，通过查询向量与预计算子图表示的比较来检测行为。为应对图规模与复杂度，作者设计了图划分和行为保持的图约简，使大部分计算可离线完成，查询时仅做轻量比较。在标准数据集上，该方法检测准确率超过 99%，误报率约 0.02%，优于其他对比方法。

paper.title: NestFuzz: Enhancing Fuzzing with Comprehensive Understanding of Input Processing Logic
paper.description: Fuzzing is one of the most popular and practical techniques for security analysis. In this work, we aim to address the critical problem of high-quality input generation with a novel input-aware fuzzing approach called NestFuzz. NestFuzz can universally and automatically model input format specifications and generate valid input.
paper.author: Peng Deng, Zhemin Yang, Lei Zhang, Guangliang Yang, Wenzheng Hong, Yuan Zhang, Min Yang
paper.summary_zh: 模糊测试是实用的安全分析技术，但如何生成能深入程序逻辑的高质量输入仍是关键难题，随机变异往往难以产生合法输入。本文提出 NestFuzz，一种输入感知的模糊测试方法，能够通用且自动地建模输入格式规范并生成有效输入。它通过理解程序对输入的处理逻辑来指导测试用例生成，从而提高模糊测试的覆盖率和漏洞发现能力。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但作者表明该方法可增强模糊测试的效果并具有通用性。

paper.title: Assume but Verify: Deductive Verification of Leaked Information in Concurrent Applications
paper.description: We consider the problem of specifying and proving the security of non-trivial, concurrent programs that intentionally leak information. We present a method that decomposes the problem into (a) proving that the program only leaks information it has declassified via assume annotations already widely used in deductive program verification; and (b) auditing the declassifications against a declarative security policy.
